units.content: The Traveller finds the Sphinx's bronze valves already open.

evidence.quote: the sphinx I found the bronze valves were open

units.content: The Time Machine is waiting inside the Sphinx's small apartment.

evidence.quote: this was the Time Machine

The matches were of that abominable kind that light only on the

evidence.quote: But at last the lever was fixed and pulled over

units.label: Motionless Red Sun
units.content: The far-future sun hangs huge, red, and motionless on the horizon.

evidence.quote: stopped, the sun, red and very large, halted motionless upon the

units.content: Tidal friction has finished its work and locked Earth with one face to the sun.

evidence.quote: that the work of the tidal drag was done

units.label: Motionless Red Sun Sky

where, cut by the horizon, lay the
huge hull of the sun, red and motionless

units.content: The Time Machine rests on a sloping beach beside a windless sea.

evidence.quote: The machine was standing on a sloping beach

units.content: The Traveller feels head oppression and rapid breathing from rarefied air.

evidence.quote:
There was a sense of
oppression in my head, and I noticed that I was breathing very fast

evidence.quote: Then I saw the thing was really a monstrous crab-like creature

units.content: Another monster crab stands just behind the Traveller and reaches for him with eyestalks, hungry mouth, and slime-smeared claws.

evidence.quote:
I saw that I had grasped the antenna of
another monster crab that stood just behind me

units.label: Escape By Time Lever
units.content: The Traveller puts his hand on the lever and places a month between himself and the monsters.

evidence.quote: In a moment my hand was on the lever, and I had placed a month

units.label: Abominable Desolate World

evidence.quote: The red eastern sky, the northward blackness, the salt Dead Sea

units.content: A curved pale line like a vast new moon appears in the westward sky.
units.state: The Vast New Moon Line is no longer visible now that the Eclipse over sun has deepened into absolute darkness where Pale stars alone remain.

evidence.quote:
And in the westward sky, I saw a curved pale line like a
vast new moon

units.label: Millennia-Long Sun Watching
units.content: Drawn by the earth's fate, the Traveller journeys in thousand-year strides while watching the sun grow larger and duller.

evidence.quote:
watching with a strange fascination the sun grow larger and duller in
the westward sky

units.content: More than thirty million years on the crabs have disappeared, the red beach seems lifeless, and it is flecked with white.

evidence.quote:
Then I
stopped once more, for the crawling multitude of crabs had disappeared,

seemed lifeless. And now it was flecked with white

units.label: Motionless lifeless world
units.content: No animal movement remains in earth, sky, or sea.

evidence.quote: But I saw nothing moving, in earth or sky or sea

units.label: Last green slime life
units.content: Green slime on the rocks alone shows that life is not yet extinct.

evidence.quote:
The green
slime on the rocks alone testified that life was not extinct

units.content: A bay-like black concavity grows on the sun as an eclipse begins.

but there is
much to incline me to believe that what I really saw was the transit of

units.label: End of living sounds
units.content: All familiar sounds of humans and animals are over in universal silence.

evidence.quote:

sheep, the cries of birds, the hum of insects, the stir that makes the

units.label: Pale stars alone
units.content: Darkness becomes absolute until only pale stars remain visible.
units.state: Darkness is no longer absolute with only pale stars because the sun's edge has reappeared.

evidence.quote:
In another moment the pale
stars alone were visible

units.label: Overcome by cold horror
units.content: The Traveller is overcome by horror, marrow-piercing cold, painful breathing, shivering and nausea.

evidence.quote:
The cold, that smote to my
marrow, and the pain I felt in breathing, overcame me

units.label: Red-hot solar edge
units.content: The edge of the sun reappears in the sky like a red-hot bow.

evidence.quote:
Then like a red-hot bow in the sky appeared
the edge of the sun

units.label: Hopping tentacled round thing
units.content: A black round football-sized thing with trailing tentacles hops fitfully against the blood-red water.

evidence.quote:
It was a round thing, the size of a football perhaps, or, it may
be, bigger, and tentacles trailed down from it

units.label: Backward flight through time
units.content: He travels backward as the blinking succession of days and nights resumes with golden sun and blue sky.

evidence.quote:
The blinking succession of the days and nights was resumed,
the sun got golden again, the sky blue

units.label: Reversed Mrs Watchett walk
units.content: On repassing the departure minute Mrs. Watchett glides backward up the laboratory with every motion exactly inverted.

evidence.quote:
But now her every motion appeared to be the
exact inversion of her previous ones

units.label: Familiar Laboratory Return
units.content: The Traveller stops the machine to find his familiar laboratory exactly as he left it.

evidence.quote:
Then I stopped the machine, and saw about me again the old familiar
laboratory, my tools, my appliances just as I had left them

units.label: Displaced Machine Evidence
units.content: The machine's shift from southeast to northwest measures the distance to the White Sphinx pedestal.

evidence.quote:
The thing had started from the south-east corner
of the laboratory. It had come to rest again in the north-west, against
the wall where you saw it

units.label: Dinner Guests Rejoined
units.content: Injured and begrimed, the Traveller hears his friends dining and re-enters through the door.

evidence.quote:
I heard your voices
and the clatter of plates

units.label: Return Feels Incredible
units.content: The Traveller says his own safe return to familiar company feels more incredible than his adventures.

evidence.quote:
that all this will be absolutely
incredible to you, but to me the one incredible thing is that I am here

units.label: Lie Or Prophecy Framing
units.content: The Traveller offers his account to be taken as a lie, dream, or prophecy rather than believed truth.

evidence.quote: Take it as a lie—or a prophecy

units.label: Asking for Story Verdict
units.content: The Traveller asks his audience to judge his narrative simply as a story.

evidence.quote: And taking it as a story, what do you think of it?

units.label: Restless sceptical audience
units.content: The audience grows restless and silent after the story ends.
units.state: The Restless sceptical audience has now broken up and departed with laughter in the Laughing midnight farewell.

evidence.quote:
Then chairs began to creak and shoes to scrape upon the
carpet

units.label: Editor dismisses tale
units.content: The Editor treats the account as fiction fit for a story-writer.

evidence.quote:
What a pity it is you’re not a writer
of stories!” he said, putting his hand on the Time Traveller’s
shoulder

units.label: Traveller doubts himself
units.content: The Time Traveller admits he hardly believes his own experience himself.

evidence.quote: hardly believe it myself..... And yet

units.label: Withered white flowers
units.content: The Traveller gazes in mute inquiry at the withered white flowers on the table.

evidence.quote:
His eye fell with a mute inquiry upon the withered white flowers upon
the little table

units.label: Scarred knuckles evidence
units.content: The Traveller looks at half-healed scars on his own knuckles.

evidence.quote: he was looking at some half-healed scars on his knuckles

units.label: Refusal to give flowers
units.content: When the Medical Man asks to have the unidentified flowers, the Traveller abruptly refuses.

evidence.quote: The Time Traveller hesitated. Then suddenly: “Certainly not

units.label: Traveller doubting his memory
units.content: The Traveller feels ordinary reality overwhelming his memory and fears his journey was only a dream.

evidence.quote:
Did I ever make a Time Machine,
or a model of a Time Machine?

units.label: Lamp-lit dash to corridor
units.content: The Traveller seizes the lamp and leads his followers into the corridor to check the machine.

evidence.quote:
He caught up the lamp swiftly, and carried it, flaring red, through the
door into the corridor

units.label: Solid travel-stained machine
units.content: The machine is physically present, solid and touchable, marked by stains, grass, moss, and a bent rail.

evidence.quote:
with
brown spots and smears upon the ivory, and bits of grass and moss upon
the lower parts, and one rail bent awry

units.label: Story affirmed as true
units.content: After touching the damaged rail the Traveller declares that the story he told was true.

evidence.quote:
It’s all right now,” he said. “The story I
told you was true

units.label: Laughing midnight farewell
units.content: The party breaks up with an overwork diagnosis, laughter, and the Traveller shouting good-night from the doorway.

evidence.quote:
I
remember him standing in the open doorway, bawling good-night

units.label: Divided Aftermath of Tale
units.content: The Editor dismisses the tale as a gaudy lie while the narrator remains unable to conclude after a sleepless night.

evidence.quote:
He thought the tale a “gaudy lie.” For
my own part I was unable to come to a conclusion

units.label: Touching the Lever
units.content: Alone in the empty laboratory, the narrator stares at the Time Machine and touches its lever.

evidence.quote:
I stared for a minute at the Time Machine and put
out my hand and touched the lever

units.label: Swaying Machine Vision
units.content: The squat substantial-looking mass sways unsteadily like a wind-shaken bough.

evidence.quote:
At that the squat
substantial-looking mass swayed like a bough shaken by the wind

units.label: Equipped Departing Traveller
units.content: The Time Traveller appears from the house carrying a small camera and a knapsack.

evidence.quote:
He had a small camera under one arm and a
knapsack under the other

units.label: Promise of Proof
units.content: The Traveller promises to prove time travelling completely with specimens if the narrator stays to lunch.

evidence.quote:
If you’ll stop to lunch I’ll prove you this time
travelling up to the hilt, specimens and all

units.label: Leaving to Warn Traveller
units.content: Remembering a two o’clock engagement, the narrator gets up to tell the Time Traveller he must go.

evidence.quote:
I got up and went down the passage to tell the
Time Traveller

units.label: Traveller's Abrupt Vanishing
units.content: The narrator enters amid noise and gust to find the Time Traveller gone from the laboratory.

evidence.quote: The Time Traveller was not there

units.label: Three-Year Vain Waiting
units.content: The narrator waits on for the Traveller, but he has now been absent for three years.

evidence.quote: The Time Traveller vanished three years ago

units.label: Speculated Prehistoric Wanderings
units.content: The narrator imagines the Traveller may be lost wandering among remote prehistoric ages.

evidence.quote: beside the lonely saline seas of the Triassic Age

units.label: Future as Black Blank
units.content: To the narrator the future remains a black and blank vast ignorance.

evidence.quote: But to me the future is still black and blank—is

units.label: Withered White Flowers Witness
units.content: Two shrivelled white flowers remain as witness that gratitude and tenderness survived in man.

evidence.quote:
two strange white
flowers—shrivelled now, and brown and flat and brittle—to witness that

revisions.new_reading: First sight of watchers is now a first glimpse of the same frail Watching Uniform Diners peering from already worn and dilapidated houses, not powerful overseers in intact splendour.
revisions.rationale: First sight of watchers previously showed splendid houses inhabited by decline, but Glimmering Future Architecture now means physically worn grandeur after Dilapidated Look Strikes, and Watching Uniform Diners with Worn White-Metal Floor show the same watching frail crowd in decay, so the houses themselves are decaying.

revisions.new_reading: The Thames valley sunset is now also to be read as a figure for mankind's own sunset, in addition to remaining a scenic panorama.
revisions.rationale: Sunset of Mankind explicitly turns the ruddy sunset into a figure for decline, inviting a symbolic reading of the earlier sunset panorama.

revisions.new_reading: The condition of ruinous splendour is now to be understood as the aftermath of the civilising climax, where complete security removed need and left splendour without vigour to maintain it.
revisions.rationale: Civilising Amelioration Climax together with the idea that security rewards feebleness explains the earlier confusing mix of ruin and splendour as triumph followed by enfeeblement.

revisions.old_reading: Massive splendid buildings remain seen, but they no longer signify vastly superior inhabitants; childlike frail people show architectural splendour can coexist with intellectual decline.
revisions.new_reading: Glimmering Future Architecture is now also to be read as relics of the civilising climax left to decay after security enfeebled their maintainers.
revisions.rationale: Ruinous Splendour Condition now explains ruinous splendour as aftermath of the climax where Civilising Amelioration Climax made life secure, and Humanity Upon the Wane identifies the builders as declining, so massive splendid buildings add the role of abandoned peak-work to remaining a scenic glimpse.

revisions.new_reading: Granite Aluminium Ruin is now also to be read as splendour left derelict because security removed need and vigour to maintain it.
revisions.rationale: Granite Aluminium Ruin supported Ruinous Splendour Condition, which now means splendour without vigour after Civilising Amelioration Climax, while Security Rewards Feebleness states security sets a premium on feebleness, so the derelict heap adds illustration of enfeebled abandonment.

revisions.new_reading: Frail Future People are now also to be read as enfeebled by perfect security which rewarded feebleness.
revisions.rationale: Frail Future People already contradicted Future humanity turned cruel, and Humanity Upon the Wane plus Security Rewards Feebleness now give its frailty a cause as the outcome of need removed, adding enfeeblement-by-security to remaining slight and beautiful.

revisions.new_reading: Earth Become Garden is now also to be read as subjugated nature left untended after need and vigour faded.
revisions.rationale: Earth Become Garden described garden without agriculture, which Future Subjugation of Nature reframes as deliberately readjusted animal and vegetable life, while Security Rewards Feebleness and Ruinous Splendour Condition explain why such plenty is now neglected and ruinous.

revisions.new_reading: Weedless Neglected Future Garden is now also to be read as subjugated nature staying weedless combined with neglect from enfeebled maintainers.
revisions.rationale: Weedless Neglected Future Garden supported Ruinous Splendour Condition, now understood as climax aftermath, where Future Subjugation of Nature explains weedlessness as controlled life and Security Rewards Feebleness explains long neglect as loss of vigour.

revisions.old_reading: The condition of ruinous splendour is now to be understood as the aftermath of the civilising climax, where complete security removed need and left splendour without vigour to maintain it.
revisions.new_reading: The condition of ruinous splendour is now to be read as proof of perfect conquest: vast grandeur as what conquest built and ruin as what contented inactivity then allowed.
revisions.rationale: The perfect conquest idea explicitly takes vast ruins together with frailty as proof of completed conquest, adding evidential meaning to the previously puzzling ruinous splendour.

revisions.old_reading: Frail Future People are now also to be read as enfeebled by perfect security which rewarded feebleness.
revisions.new_reading: Frail future people are now also to be read as the end-point after secure energy burned briefly in art and eroticism and then sank into languor, not only as direct enfeeblement by security.
revisions.rationale: The energy decays through art claim inserts a brief artistic and erotic flowering between security and languor, adding a stage to the existing enfeeblement-by-security reading of frailty.

revisions.old_reading: Massive splendid buildings remain seen, but they no longer signify vastly superior inhabitants; childlike frail people show architectural splendour can coexist with intellectual decline.
revisions.new_reading: Glimmering Future Architecture is now also to be read as grandeur built by perfect conquest and left to ruin by contented inactivity.
revisions.rationale: Ruinous Splendour Condition is now explained by Perfect Conquest of Nature as grandeur built by conquest then ruined by inactivity, so Glimmering Future Architecture gains that origin story while still showing splendour coexisting with decline.

revisions.new_reading: Childlike Sun Thunder Question is now also to be read as illustration that Victorian restless energy become weakness left only childlike intellect.
revisions.rationale: Expected Future Superiority is now denied by Strength Becomes Weakness, so Childlike Sun Thunder Question still contradicts expectation but now also exemplifies strength turned to weakness.

revisions.old_reading: Granite Aluminium Ruin is now also to be read as splendour left derelict because security removed need and vigour to maintain it.
revisions.new_reading: Granite Aluminium Ruin is now also to be read as grandeur built by perfect conquest then left derelict after secure energy passed through art into languor.
revisions.rationale: Ruinous Splendour Condition is now proof of Perfect Conquest of Nature and Energy Decays Through Art, so Granite Aluminium Ruin keeps its derelict-splendour sense while gaining conquest-built origin and art-to-languor mechanism.

revisions.new_reading: Delicate Future People are now also to be read as the languor endpoint after secure energy burned briefly in art and eroticism, not only as directly enfeebled by security.
revisions.rationale: Frail Future People are now reinterpreted through Energy Decays Through Art as an art-to-languor endpoint, and Delicate Future People refines that frailty so inherits the longer decay sequence.

revisions.new_reading: Toilless Social Paradise is now also to be read as the perfect security that made strength useless and sent surplus energy through brief art into languor.
revisions.rationale: Ruinous Splendour Condition is now proof of Perfect Conquest of Nature, and Toilless Social Paradise specifies its splendid side, so the toilless condition gains a causal role through Strength Becomes Weakness and Energy Decays Through Art.

revisions.old_reading: The Full-size Time Machine now lies in the future garden with its starting levers unscrewed and removed.
revisions.new_reading: The Full-size Time Machine is no longer lying on the lawn by the Sphinx; it has vanished.
revisions.rationale: Time Machine Vanished reports the machine is gone, which ends the prior state of Full-size Time Machine lying in the future garden.

revisions.old_reading: The big machine remains in the future garden but now has its starting levers unscrewed and removed to prevent it being set in motion.
revisions.new_reading: The Large unfinished time machine is no longer waiting in the future garden with levers removed but has vanished from the lawn by the Sphinx with the Full-size Time Machine as shown by Time Machine Vanished.
revisions.rationale: The Full-size Time Machine refines the Large unfinished time machine as the same machine, and Time Machine Vanished establishes that machine is now gone from the lawn, so the prior remaining-in-garden state no longer holds.

revisions.new_reading: The watching smile should now be understood as mocking triumph hinting at hostile intervention, not merely curious watching at astonishment.
revisions.rationale: The moonlit mocking smile in this passage suggests the earlier watching smile was already mockery, adding hostile meaning to idle observation.

revisions.new_reading: The Colossal White Winged Statue is now understood as a mocking triumphant watcher hinting at hostile intervention like the Smiling Marble Sphinx Watcher and Mocking sphinx smile, not merely a neutral looming monument.
revisions.rationale: The Smiling Marble Sphinx Watcher refines the Colossal White Winged Statue by adding a watching smile to the looming figure, and that smile is now read as mocking triumph because the Mocking sphinx smile shows the sphinx smiling in mockery of dismay and the Unsuspected intervening power shows an unknown power made the invention vanish.

revisions.new_reading: He is no longer in gashed-knuckle frenzy but awake in morning freshness and able to face his situation rationally.
revisions.rationale: Morning Calm Recovery shows composure returning after the night of frenzied beating described in Bloody bush beating.

revisions.new_reading: He no longer disregards the little people but resolves to be calm and patient to learn them as part of recovering or remaking the machine.
revisions.rationale: Calm Patient Resolve explicitly commits to learning the people, replacing the earlier disregard described in Traveller Disregards Hosts.

revisions.old_reading: The Colossal White Winged Statue is now understood as a mocking triumphant watcher hinting at hostile intervention like the Smiling Marble Sphinx Watcher and Mocking sphinx smile, not merely a neutral looming monument.
revisions.new_reading: The bronze base beneath the looming white figure is also to be understood as a hollow container with door-like panels that can hide the machine, in addition to being a mocking watcher.
revisions.rationale: Hollow Bronze Pedestal reveals through rapping that the pedestal is hollow, adding a hiding-place function to Colossal White Winged Statue.

revisions.new_reading: The hollow pedestal is also to be read as a forbidden object whose opening provokes horror and insult, in addition to being a hollow container with door-like panels.
revisions.rationale: Hollow Bronze Pedestal describes the pedestal as hollow with framed panels like doors, while Eloi Horror at Request shows the Eloi treating any gesture toward opening it as a gross insult and withdrawing, adding a social prohibition to its meaning.

revisions.new_reading: The bronze pedestal remains closed, but a coil in its decoration is now flattened and verdigris has come off in powdery flakes from hammering.
revisions.rationale: Hollow Bronze Pedestal describes hollow bronze panels like doors, while Hammering Bronze Pedestal shows those panels battered with a pebble until decoration flattened and verdigris scattered without opening.

revisions.new_reading: The odd cupola-covered well-like structure is now to be understood as one instance of many bronze-rimmed ventilation shafts belonging to an extensive subterranean system, not an isolated oddity.
revisions.rationale: The ventilation inference shows the briefly noticed cupola-covered oddity belongs to a system of throbbing inhaling shafts.

revisions.new_reading: The confident claim to have mastered the whole secret is now to be understood as mistaken overconfidence in an obvious sanitary interpretation that is retracted as absolutely wrong.
revisions.rationale: The admission of error directly qualifies the earlier mastery claim as premature.

revisions.new_reading: The impression of automatic organisation is now to be understood as a provisional first theory that the Traveller has abandoned as unsatisfying, not a retained conclusion.
revisions.rationale: Failed First Theories explicitly says the automatic civilisation theorizing did not last, so the earlier general impression can no longer stand as his view.

revisions.old_reading: He no longer disregards the little people but resolves to be calm and patient to learn them as part of recovering or remaking the machine.
revisions.new_reading: He no longer disregards the little people but cherishes Weena's clinging fondness, watches for her, and feels returning to the White Sphinx neighbourhood almost like coming home.
revisions.rationale: The coming-home image and week-long friendship show disregard has turned into personal attachment and home feeling centred on Weena.

revisions.new_reading: The cushioned hall of sleepers should now be understood not as casual rest but as the fear-driven nightly huddle against darkness.
revisions.rationale: Eloi Huddle After Dark reveals gathering to sleep in droves as a general habit after dark, which adds motive to Cushioned sleeping hall.

revisions.new_reading: The fancy of a greyish animal rushing from the chamber should now be understood as likely a real glimpse of the same hasty white creatures seen at dawn, not mere dream-confusion.
revisions.rationale: Repeated sightings of fast white figures that vanish make the earlier fleeting intruder seem like the same kind of being.

revisions.new_reading: The belief that fear is forgotten should now be read as true only of daylight behaviour; dawn apparitions and lingering foreboding show dread persists beyond daylight.
revisions.rationale: Haunting foreboding after seeing carriers at dawn directly qualifies the earlier daylight-based generalization.

revisions.new_reading: Perfect Conquest of Nature should now be read as a daylight-only illusion undermined by persisting dread beyond daylight.
revisions.rationale: Fear forgotten belief now holds only for daylight behaviour while Foreboding deadlier possession shows haunting dread persists, removing the support for a completed conquest.

revisions.new_reading: Absence of burial signs should now be read as pointing to hidden disposal of the dead by the burden-carrying white creatures rather than absence of death.
revisions.rationale: No aged or infirm is contradicted by Leash carrying dark body implying injury or death, making the lack of tombs an ominous gap filled by the white creatures.

revisions.new_reading: Gibbous Moon Rising should now be read as the nightly onset of fearful hours confirmed by dawn apparitions rather than mere picturesque nightfall.
revisions.rationale: Fear forgotten belief is now limited to daylight while Foreboding deadlier possession and Ghastly dawn half-light show dread surrounding night and dawn, giving the moonrise foreboding significance.

revisions.old_reading: The odd cupola-covered well-like structure is now to be understood as one instance of many bronze-rimmed ventilation shafts belonging to an extensive subterranean system, not an isolated oddity.
revisions.new_reading: The cupola-covered well is an inhabited access shaft with a ladder used by the pale creatures to move between surface and below, not only a ventilation shaft.
revisions.rationale: Seeing the creature retreat down the shaft shows the wells are thoroughfares for the subterranean inhabitants.

revisions.old_reading: Delicate Future People are now also to be read as the languor endpoint after secure energy burned briefly in art and eroticism, not only as directly enfeebled by security.
revisions.new_reading: The delicate Dresden-china people are only the surface branch of a humanity now split into two distinct species, still showing enfeeblement after security but no longer taken as the whole of humanity.
revisions.rationale: The split claim requires the frail surface dwellers previously taken for all future people to be reread as one of two animals alongside the pale nocturnal creatures.

revisions.new_reading: Humanity upon the wane is now to be understood as differentiation into two distinct species, not simple decline of a single humanity.
revisions.rationale: Concluding that humanity split into two distinct animals qualifies the earlier perception of general decline.

revisions.new_reading: The Bronze-rimmed circular wells are now to be read as inhabited access shafts with ladders used by the pale branch to move between surface and below, not only as ventilation shafts.
revisions.rationale: Well Under Cupola was revised by Well Shaft Sighting from only ventilation to inhabited access with a ladder, and since Bronze-rimmed circular wells refines Well Under Cupola, the same addition applies, supported by Shaft Ladder Rests.

revisions.old_reading: Frail Future People are now also to be read as enfeebled by perfect security which rewarded feebleness.
revisions.new_reading: The Frail Future People are now to be read as only the surface branch of a humanity split into two species, still frail from security but no longer the whole of humanity.
revisions.rationale: Delicate Future People refines Frail Future People and was reframed by Humanity Split Species from all humanity to only one surface branch, so the frailty account must be scoped the same way.

revisions.old_reading: The fear that future men became cruel and overwhelmingly powerful now looks misplaced; the encountered future people present as slight, beautiful and frail rather than as an overwhelming threat.
revisions.new_reading: The fear that Future humanity turned cruel can no longer be dismissed as misplaced from surface frailty alone now that Humanity Split Species leaves a second underground branch still to be judged.
revisions.rationale: Humanity Upon the Wane was revised by Humanity Split Species from decline of a single humanity to differentiation into two, so the contradiction with Future humanity turned cruel no longer disposes of cruelty, especially with Pale Nocturnal Creature still unassessed.

revisions.new_reading: The extensive ventilation arrangement should now be understood as a provisional surface account suspected of concealing a deeper true import.
revisions.rationale: The doubt explicitly says the ventilation idea may hide its true import, which adds a layer of suspicion without denying the shafts exist.

revisions.old_reading: The odd cupola-covered well-like structure is now to be understood as one instance of many bronze-rimmed ventilation shafts belonging to an extensive subterranean system, not an isolated oddity.
revisions.new_reading: The cupola-covered well should now be read as one node in a unified puzzle connecting wells, ventilating towers, ghostly appearances, bronze gates and the missing machine, not only as a ventilation shaft.
revisions.rationale: The clue explicitly groups the wells with those other phenomena, which expands what the well signifies without denying its physical description.

revisions.new_reading: The throbbing inhaling shaft test should now be read as a physical trace of deeper inhabited activity feeding the unified puzzle, not only as evidence for ventilation.
revisions.rationale: The Throbbing inhaling shaft test gave physical evidence for the Subterranean ventilation system, but the Ventilation true import doubt now treats that ventilation arrangement as a provisional surface account, while the Emerging unified explanation clue repositions wells and ventilating towers inside a larger mystery.

revisions.old_reading: The Bronze-rimmed circular wells are now to be read as inhabited access shafts with ladders used by the pale branch to move between surface and below, not only as ventilation shafts.
revisions.new_reading: The bronze-rimmed circular wells should now be read as nodes in the unified puzzle linking wells, towers, ghosts, bronze gates and the missing machine while remaining inhabited access shafts.
revisions.rationale: The Bronze-rimmed circular wells develops the Well Under Cupola, and the Well Under Cupola is now to be understood as one node in a unified puzzle from the Emerging unified explanation clue, so the detailed wells must inherit that wider role in addition to remaining inhabited access shafts.

revisions.new_reading: The well shaft sighting should now be read as the unassimilable Lemur encounter that breaks the balanced-organization scheme and supplies the unified clue, as well as proof of habitation.
revisions.rationale: The Well Shaft Sighting showed habitation in the Well Under Cupola, but the Lemur balance scheme puzzle now makes that creature the anomaly that the Automatic organisation impression cannot accommodate, and the Emerging unified explanation clue makes wells plus ghosts part of one puzzle.

revisions.new_reading: Absence by day and appearance as creatures of half-light should now be understood as daytime retreat underground by a light-sensitive race, not as insubstantiality.
revisions.rationale: The theory of retinal pain and subterranean habit shows the earlier daylight absence reflects avoidance of sunshine, making the ghost dismissal mistaken.

revisions.new_reading: Ventilation shafts are now to be understood as airways for an inhabited artificial Underworld that houses the subterranean race and its work, resolving the earlier suspicion of a hidden import.
revisions.rationale: The tunnelling claim answers the earlier doubt about ventilation by identifying the true import as a populated underworld.

revisions.old_reading: Frail Future People are now also to be read as enfeebled by perfect security which rewarded feebleness.
revisions.new_reading: The slight beautiful frail people are now also to be understood as descendants of the Capitalist upper branch maintained by underground labour, in addition to being enfeebled by security.
revisions.rationale: The class-split key gives a social ancestry to the earlier frail surface branch now known to be only half of split humanity.

revisions.new_reading: White figures on hill are now to be read as real surface forays of the light-sensitive subterranean race rather than insubstantial half-light apparitions.
revisions.rationale: Dismissal as ghosts is revised from insubstantiality to daytime retreat underground, while Subterranean Second Species establishes a plainly subterranean race and Extreme Retinal Sensitivity proves light-driven retreat, so White figures on hill can no longer stand as denied apparitions.

revisions.old_reading: The extensive ventilation arrangement should now be understood as a provisional surface account suspected of concealing a deeper true import.
revisions.new_reading: Subterranean ventilation system is now to be read as airways for an inhabited artificial Underworld housing the subterranean race and its labour rather than mere ventilation.
revisions.rationale: Ventilation true import doubt suspected a hidden import behind ventilation, and Tunnelled Underground Habitat plus Underworld Labour Service resolve it as an enormously tunnelled habitat where work for the daylight race is done, so Subterranean ventilation system is no longer provisional.

revisions.old_reading: Delicate Future People are now also to be read as the languor endpoint after secure energy burned briefly in art and eroticism, not only as directly enfeebled by security.
revisions.new_reading: Delicate Future People are now also to be read as the Capitalist-descended surface branch maintained by hidden underground labour while remaining the languor endpoint.
revisions.rationale: Frail Future People are now also descendants of the Capitalist upper branch, and Capitalist-Labourer Split Key plus Underworld Labour Service give that branch its split origin and maintenance, which refines Delicate Future People as the same surface people without replacing languor.

revisions.old_reading: The fear that future men became cruel and overwhelmingly powerful now looks misplaced; the encountered future people present as slight, beautiful and frail rather than as an overwhelming threat.
revisions.new_reading: Future humanity turned cruel is now to be read as no longer dismissible as misplaced because the overwhelming threat may reside in the subterranean second branch rather than the frail surface people.
revisions.rationale: Future humanity turned cruel looked misplaced against Frail Future People, but Frail Future People are now only the surface branch while Subterranean Second Species and Capitalist-Labourer Split Key establish a second underground branch still to be judged.

revisions.old_reading: Perfect Conquest of Nature should now be read as a daylight-only illusion undermined by persisting dread beyond daylight.
revisions.new_reading: Perfect Conquest of Nature is now also to be read as a daylight illusion sustained by hidden underground labour for the Capitalist-descended surface branch rather than true conquest.
revisions.rationale: Perfect Conquest of Nature already stood as a daylight-only illusion, and Frail Future People becoming Capitalist descendants plus Underworld Labour Service and Capitalist-Labourer Split Key now supply the hidden labour mechanism that sustains the illusion.

revisions.old_reading: Ventilation shafts are now to be understood as airways for an inhabited artificial Underworld that houses the subterranean race and its work, resolving the earlier suspicion of a hidden import.
revisions.new_reading: Ventilation shafts are now also to be read as instruments of economic coercion where underground dwellers pay rent for air or face starvation and suffocation.
revisions.rationale: Rent For Underground Air adds that ventilation involves heavy rent with starvation or suffocation for arrears, deepening the earlier suspicion of a hidden import beyond mere airways.

revisions.old_reading: Perfect Conquest of Nature should now be read as a daylight-only illusion undermined by persisting dread beyond daylight.
revisions.new_reading: Perfect conquest should now also be read as an aristocratic domination carrying the present industrial system to its conclusion, not a moral or cooperative triumph over nature.
revisions.rationale: Aristocratic Triumph Over Fellow-Man reframes the triumph behind splendid buildings and frail people as domination by an aristocracy armed with perfected science.

revisions.new_reading: The civilising climax is now to be understood as passed, with balanced civilisation past its zenith and sunk into degeneration.
revisions.rationale: Overworlder Degeneration In Decay says balanced civilisation has passed its zenith, so the steady advance to a climax described in Civilising Amelioration Climax now leads onward to decline.

revisions.old_reading: Subterranean ventilation system is now to be read as airways for an inhabited artificial Underworld housing the subterranean race and its labour rather than mere ventilation.
revisions.new_reading: Subterranean ventilation system is now also to be read as a rent-extraction apparatus enforcing the Haves Above Workers Below split, in addition to airways for an inhabited Underworld.
revisions.rationale: Ventilation true import doubt is now also read through Rent For Underground Air as coercive rent for air, so Subterranean ventilation system as the concrete ventilation arrangement gains that economic-coercive significance while remaining airways for underground labour.

revisions.new_reading: Future Subjugation of Nature is now to be read as a mistaken cooperative ideal exposed as Aristocratic Triumph Over Fellow-Man rather than a future moral reshaping of life.
revisions.rationale: Future Subjugation of Nature predicts wisely cooperative readjustment of life, while Aristocratic Triumph Over Fellow-Man denies moral cooperation and Perfect Conquest of Nature is reframed as aristocratic domination, so the cooperative expectation no longer holds as stated.

revisions.new_reading: Tunnelled Underground Habitat is now also to be read as rented caverns for which the Workers pay ventilation rent, in addition to habitat of the New Race.
revisions.rationale: Tunnelled Underground Habitat gives concrete form to Ventilation true import doubt, and Ventilation true import doubt now includes Rent For Underground Air where caverns require heavy rent for ventilation, so the habitat gains that rented-coercive meaning while remaining habitat.

revisions.new_reading: The moon is no longer gibbous and bright; it is waning toward its last quarter with nights growing dark.
revisions.rationale: Gibbous illumination described earlier has passed; passage explicitly says the moon must pass through last quarter and nights grow dark.

revisions.new_reading: The deadlock of must descend yet afraid to go is over; he has committed to and begun the descent into the well.
revisions.rationale: The earlier Resolve versus fear situation left him afraid to go, while this passage resolve and entry show him climbing down despite fear and Weena's protest.

revisions.new_reading: Traveller's Lonely Paralysis is ended when Resolve for Immediate Descent overcomes horror to produce Entry Into Well Throat.
revisions.rationale: Traveller's Lonely Paralysis meant being appalled by horrid aloneness into inaction, while Resolve versus fear now records the deadlock as over and Resolve for Immediate Descent followed by Entry Into Well Throat show him acting despite fear, so the fact of paralysis has passed in time without changing what the horror meant.

revisions.new_reading: Expected Future Superiority should now be understood as a naive absurd assumption about inevitable progress, not as a reasonable forecast.
revisions.rationale: The confession of absurd assumption shows the earlier expectation of vast superiority was naive, changing how that expectation should be understood.

revisions.new_reading: The chuckle stirring inside the pedestal should now be understood as real Morlock mocking laughter, not a mistake, anticipating the mocking pursuit in the dark.
revisions.rationale: Chuckle Inside Pedestal was dismissed as mistaken, but the current account of being mocked and chased in the dark by Morlocks suggests such laughter was real.

revisions.new_reading: Time Machine Built Vain should now be understood as disappointment caused by the collapse of Expected Future Superiority now exposed as Absurd future progress assumption.
revisions.rationale: Expected Future Superiority was revised from reasonable forecast to naive absurd assumption because of Absurd future progress assumption, so the feeling in Time Machine Built Vain is now understood as self-inflicted by that absurd expectation rather than as objective proof that time travel was worthless.

revisions.new_reading: He has now acted on the resisted impulse and climbed rapidly up the shaft to escape the Morlocks, leaving the Underworld.
revisions.rationale: Retreat Impulse Resisted said he considered climbing back up but kept descending; Violent Shaft Escape shows he now does climb up to escape seizure.

revisions.new_reading: Enduring Fear of Darkness should now also be read as well-founded dread of being seized by Morlocks in the dark, with sunlight and Eloi companionship as relief.
revisions.rationale: Enduring Fear of Darkness spoke of fear concentrated in darkness; the fight with clutching hands in the dark and collapse into sunlight tended by Weena and the Eloi reveals what that darkness holds.

revisions.new_reading: Traveller Missed The Lesson now also reads as his failure to grasp that fear of darkness meant literal danger of being seized by Morlocks.
revisions.rationale: Enduring Fear of Darkness is now well-founded dread of being seized in the dark, and Morlocks Haul Traveller Back shows hands clutching to haul him back, so Traveller Missed The Lesson gains concrete validation as missing that specific predatory danger.

revisions.old_reading: Frail Future People are now also to be read as enfeebled by perfect security which rewarded feebleness.
revisions.new_reading: The slight beautiful frail beings should now also be understood as decaying doomed prey whose former servants are creeping on as their nemesis in a reversed class order.
revisions.rationale: Reversed Class Evolution explicitly casts the delicate ones as decaying prey to a rising nemesis, adding doom to earlier readings of enfeeblement by security.

revisions.old_reading: Delicate Future People are now also to be read as the languor endpoint after secure energy burned briefly in art and eroticism, not only as directly enfeebled by security.
revisions.new_reading: The Delicate Future People are now also to be understood as decaying doomed prey whose former servants are creeping on as their nemesis.
revisions.rationale: Because Delicate Future People refines Frail Future People, the new Frail Future People understanding as doomed prey transfers directly, and Reversed Class Evolution states the Nemesis of the delicate ones was creeping on apace.

revisions.new_reading: The resolve for immediate descent no longer holds; his present resolve is to make arms and secure a sleeping fastness first.
revisions.rationale: Resolve for Immediate Descent committed to descending without waste of time, but Resolve for arms replaces it with arming and securing refuge before acting.

revisions.old_reading: Humanity upon the wane is now to be understood as differentiation into two distinct species, not simple decline of a single humanity.
revisions.new_reading: Humanity upon the wane should now also be understood as total erasure where all human activity and memory have been swept out of existence, leaving only frail creatures.
revisions.rationale: The civilization-swept-into-oblivion claim turns a gradual wane into a completed sweep out of existence.

revisions.new_reading: The unplaced memory of meat seen in the Underworld should now be understood as a shivering realization that the meat was likely the flesh of the frail prey species.
revisions.rationale: The horrible realization about meat resolves the previously unplaced intrusive memory into a specific dread about what was seen.

revisions.new_reading: The Morlocks' carnivorousness is now to be understood as feeding upon the frail surface people.
revisions.rationale: Underworld Meat Memory left the meat as an outside question supporting Morlocks are meat-eaters, but Horrible Realization About Meat gives shivering insight into what that meat might be, and Civilization Swept Into Oblivion identifies the replacement population as frail creatures, so the carnivorous claim now points to predation on the other human branch.

revisions.new_reading: The wood is now green and pleasant in morning light, approachable for fruit gathering, not black and forbidding.
revisions.rationale: Morning Fruit Foray shows the same wood under morning light as green and pleasant, changing the facts of Thick Wood Barrier's forbidding description.

revisions.old_reading: Frail Future People are now also to be read as enfeebled by perfect security which rewarded feebleness.
revisions.new_reading: Frail Future People remain slight and frail and preyed upon, but are also still recognizably human whose form compels sympathy, so they cannot be regarded with detachment as mere cattle.
revisions.rationale: Inescapable Human Sympathy shows the attempt to see the Eloi as cattle collapses because their human form demands sympathy, adding a sympathetic-humanity layer to Frail Future People.

revisions.old_reading: Delicate Future People are now also to be read as the languor endpoint after secure energy burned briefly in art and eroticism, not only as directly enfeebled by security.
revisions.new_reading: Delicate Future People remain delicate Dresden-china pretty beings but are also still recognizably human whose form compels sympathy so they cannot be regarded with detachment as mere cattle.
revisions.rationale: Delicate Future People refines Frail Future People, and Frail Future People now adds Inescapable Human Sympathy which defeats Eloi As Cattle detachment, so the delicate Dresden-china description must also carry that sympathetic-human block on cattle detachment in addition to its languor endpoint reading.

revisions.new_reading: His sustaining hope is renewed in conditional form: he now believes forcing the bronze doors with light may recover the Time Machine and allow escape.
revisions.rationale: The shattered hope account says his sustaining hope of escape was staggered, while the light entry escape belief lays out a plan to discover the Time Machine and escape, showing hope has returned.

revisions.new_reading: The hilltop immunity has ended; three pursuers now crouch in the black bushes behind the pair as night falls.
