revisions.rationale: Adjourn to smoking-room says after eating he leads the guests to the adjoining room, moving the gathering from dinner.

revisions.old_reading: He is no longer dusty, dirty and limping in tattered socks at the table; having washed, he has returned in ordinary evening clothes with only his haggard look remaining.
revisions.new_reading: The Time Traveller has finished Ravenous dinner return and completed Adjourn to smoking-room where Comfortable after-dinner gathering now waits for his long story.
revisions.rationale: The Time Traveller as animated speaker still means the same, but after Ravenous dinner return and Tense uncomfortable dinner, Adjourn to smoking-room moves Comfortable after-dinner gathering off the dinner table, so he is no longer at the table eating but in the smoking-room ready to narrate.

changes.gist: The Time Traveller demands an uninterrupted hearing for his incredible eight-day experience while the narrator sets the shadowed smoking-room scene and confesses the limits of his written retelling.
The Time Traveller recounts completing the Machine, making a brief trial hop of hours, then launching at full speed as the laboratory blurs and days flash past.

revisions.new_reading: The big machine is now completed and visibly travel-worn, with cracked ivory and a bent brass rail.
revisions.rationale: Large unfinished time machine described a nearly finished machine; Worn Completed Machine shows it standing finished but damaged from travel.

revisions.new_reading: The Full-size Time Machine is now completed and travel-worn with cracked ivory and a bent brass rail.
revisions.rationale: The Large unfinished time machine is now completed and worn, and the Worn Completed Machine shows cracked ivory and bent brass, so the Full-size Time Machine object has physically changed while meaning the same.

changes.gist: The Time Traveller describes the painful, disorienting visual blur of accelerating forward in time as days, seasons, and landscape rush past.

revisions.new_reading: The alternating black night and bright day no longer flickers distinctly but has merged into one continuous greyness with a deep blue sky at higher speed.
revisions.rationale: The Merged Continuous Greyness passage says the palpitation merged into continuous greyness, which supersedes the flickering state described in the Accelerating Day-Night Flicker passage.

changes.gist: The Traveller shifts from exhilarated curiosity about a fair future to fearful realization of the deadly risk of stopping, then impulsively halts and is thrown from the machine.

revisions.new_reading: The helpless unpleasant headlong feeling has faded and merged into hysterical exhilaration as the rush into futurity continues.
revisions.rationale: Passage says unpleasant sensations of the start were less poignant now and merged into hysterical exhilaration.

revisions.old_reading: The Full-size Time Machine is now completed and travel-worn with cracked ivory and a bent brass rail.
revisions.new_reading: The machine has reeled over and toppled during flight, throwing the traveller headlong through the air.
revisions.rationale: Passage says after lugging the lever the thing went reeling over and he was flung headlong.

revisions.old_reading: The big machine is now completed and visibly travel-worn, with cracked ivory and a bent brass rail.
revisions.new_reading: The large machine is now reeled over and toppled after Impatient Lever Pull Ejection upset Full-size Time Machine.
revisions.rationale: Full-size Time Machine has changed from complete upright to reeled over and toppled because of Impatient Lever Pull Ejection, so Large unfinished time machine can no longer be described as merely completed and travel-worn.

changes.gist: The Traveller recovers from a hail-battered landing on a garden lawn and stares at a colossal weather-worn winged statue as the storm begins to clear.

revisions.old_reading: The machine has reeled over and toppled during flight, throwing the traveller headlong through the air.
revisions.new_reading: The full-size machine now lies overturned on soft turf beside the stunned Traveller.
revisions.rationale: Full-size Time Machine is the same object as Worn Completed Machine, and Stunned Turf Landing shows that machine now overset on soft turf, so its present physical state has changed to overturned beside the Traveller.

revisions.new_reading: The hysterical exhilarated rush into futurity has now ended in a stunned stop on soft turf.
revisions.rationale: Exhilarated Confused Flight described an ongoing rush, but Stunned Turf Landing shows travel has stopped with the Traveller sitting stunned on turf, so the flight situation has terminated.

revisions.old_reading: The large machine is now reeled over and toppled after Impatient Lever Pull Ejection upset Full-size Time Machine.
revisions.new_reading: The large now-finished machine now lies overturned on soft turf beside the stunned Traveller.
revisions.rationale: Large unfinished time machine is the same object as Worn Completed Machine, and Stunned Turf Landing shows that machine now overset on turf, so its present state is overturned beside the Traveller.

changes.gist: Panicked by visions of a cruel, powerful future humanity, the Traveller tries to flee on the Time Machine, then steadies as the storm lifts and finds himself watched by robed figures.

revisions.new_reading: The hailstorm has now been swept aside and vanished, with sunlight breaking through.
revisions.rationale: Clearing Hail Sunlight Promise described thinning hail with only promise of sun; Storm vanishes like ghost shows that promise fulfilled as downpour vanishes and sun breaks through.

changes.gist: The Traveller meets a group of tiny, frail, fearless future people and removes his machine's levers while trying to communicate.

revisions.new_reading: The fear that future men became cruel and overwhelmingly powerful now looks misplaced; the encountered future people present as slight, beautiful and frail rather than as an overwhelming threat.
revisions.rationale: Seeing them as slight and frail directly qualifies the earlier dread of cruelty and overwhelming power.

revisions.new_reading: He no longer feels exposed and prey-like; the fearless bearing of the small creature has restored his confidence.
revisions.rationale: Confidence restored by lack of fear replaces the immediate prey-like vulnerability.

revisions.old_reading: The large now-finished machine now lies overturned on soft turf beside the stunned Traveller.
revisions.new_reading: The big machine remains in the future garden but now has its starting levers unscrewed and removed to prevent it being set in motion.
revisions.rationale: Unscrewing the levers changes the physical condition of the large machine from merely overturned to disabled for safety.

revisions.old_reading: The full-size machine now lies overturned on soft turf beside the stunned Traveller.
revisions.new_reading: The Full-size Time Machine now lies in the future garden with its starting levers unscrewed and removed.
revisions.rationale: Full-size Time Machine is the same object as Large unfinished time machine, and Removing Machine Levers shows its starting levers have now been unscrewed and removed, so its latest physical state has changed.

changes.gist: Close inspection of the future people's delicate beauty and their childlike misunderstanding of his gestures shatters the Traveller's expectation of advanced descendants and leaves him feeling his machine was built in vain.

revisions.new_reading: Massive splendid buildings remain seen, but they no longer signify vastly superior inhabitants; childlike frail people show architectural splendour can coexist with intellectual decline.
revisions.rationale: Childlike Sun Thunder Question shows five-year-old intellect behind thunder mimicry, which undermines the Glimmering Future Architecture suggestion of wonderful advances as proof of superior descendants.

revisions.new_reading: First sight of watchers is now understood as a first glimpse of the same Delicate Future People rather than powerful overseers, showing splendid houses inhabited by childlike decline.
revisions.rationale: First sight of watchers gave inhabitants to Glimmering Future Architecture, but after Glimmering Future Architecture was revised to mean splendour coexisting with decline, and Delicate Future People, Childlike Sun Thunder Question and Expected Future Superiority shatter expectation of advanced descendants, the robed figures watching from high signify frail childlike onlookers not imposing powers.

changes.gist: The Traveller is crowned with cultivated flowers and led like a plaything past the smiling sphinx into a vast building, while the luxuriant garden world makes his hopes for a grave intellectual posterity seem laughable.
The Traveller enters and surveys a vast communal dining hall where uniform-clad little people eat strange fruit amid worn grandeur and visible decay while watching him.

revisions.old_reading: Massive splendid buildings remain seen, but they no longer signify vastly superior inhabitants; childlike frail people show architectural splendour can coexist with intellectual decline.
revisions.new_reading: The massive splendid buildings are understood as themselves worn and dilapidated, not merely coexisting with decline but physically decaying.
revisions.rationale: The dilapidated look striking most and the floor channelled by past generations show future splendour itself is decaying, extending the earlier qualification about intellectual decline.

revisions.old_reading: First sight of watchers is now understood as a first glimpse of the same Delicate Future People rather than powerful overseers, showing splendid houses inhabited by childlike decline.
revisions.new_reading: First sight of watchers is now a first glimpse of the same frail Watching Uniform Diners peering from already worn and dilapidated houses, not powerful overseers in intact splendour.
revisions.rationale: First sight of watchers previously showed splendid houses inhabited by decline, but Glimmering Future Architecture now means physically worn grandeur after Dilapidated Look Strikes, and Watching Uniform Diners with Worn White-Metal Floor show the same watching frail crowd in decay, so the houses themselves are decaying.

changes.gist: The Traveller describes the future people's exclusively frugivorous diet and extinct animals, then recounts his slow, difficult first effort to learn their language and their indolence.
The Traveller notes the Eloi's childlike inattention, emerges into the sunset world dated A.D. 802,701, and surveys its ruinous splendour while foreshadowing a strange discovery at a derelict ruin.

The Traveller observes vanished houses and sexless uniformity and theorizes that communism and secure abundance made family and sex difference obsolete, while warning that this speculation will prove inadequate.
The Traveller climbs alone to a hill crest, surveys a sunset Thames valley turned to garden, and signals he is about to offer an interpretation he already flags as partial.
The Traveller theorizes that humanity's complete civilizing triumph over Nature removed need and struggle, thereby enfeebling mankind into decline.

revisions.new_reading: The Thames valley sunset is now also to be read as a figure for mankind's own sunset, in addition to remaining a scenic panorama.
revisions.rationale: Sunset of Mankind explicitly turns the ruddy sunset into a figure for decline, inviting a symbolic reading of the earlier sunset panorama.

revisions.new_reading: The condition of ruinous splendour is now to be understood as the aftermath of the civilising climax, where complete security removed need and left splendour without vigour to maintain it.
revisions.rationale: Civilising Amelioration Climax together with the idea that security rewards feebleness explains the earlier confusing mix of ruin and splendour as triumph followed by enfeeblement.

revisions.old_reading: Massive splendid buildings remain seen, but they no longer signify vastly superior inhabitants; childlike frail people show architectural splendour can coexist with intellectual decline.
revisions.new_reading: Glimmering Future Architecture is now also to be read as relics of the civilising climax left to decay after security enfeebled their maintainers.
revisions.rationale: Ruinous Splendour Condition now explains ruinous splendour as aftermath of the climax where Civilising Amelioration Climax made life secure, and Humanity Upon the Wane identifies the builders as declining, so massive splendid buildings add the role of abandoned peak-work to remaining a scenic glimpse.

revisions.new_reading: Granite Aluminium Ruin is now also to be read as splendour left derelict because security removed need and vigour to maintain it.
revisions.rationale: Granite Aluminium Ruin supported Ruinous Splendour Condition, which now means splendour without vigour after Civilising Amelioration Climax, while Security Rewards Feebleness states security sets a premium on feebleness, so the derelict heap adds illustration of enfeebled abandonment.

revisions.new_reading: Frail Future People are now also to be read as enfeebled by perfect security which rewarded feebleness.
revisions.rationale: Frail Future People already contradicted Future humanity turned cruel, and Humanity Upon the Wane plus Security Rewards Feebleness now give its frailty a cause as the outcome of need removed, adding enfeeblement-by-security to remaining slight and beautiful.

revisions.new_reading: Earth Become Garden is now also to be read as subjugated nature left untended after need and vigour faded.
revisions.rationale: Earth Become Garden described garden without agriculture, which Future Subjugation of Nature reframes as deliberately readjusted animal and vegetable life, while Security Rewards Feebleness and Ruinous Splendour Condition explain why such plenty is now neglected and ruinous.

revisions.new_reading: Weedless Neglected Future Garden is now also to be read as subjugated nature staying weedless combined with neglect from enfeebled maintainers.
revisions.rationale: Weedless Neglected Future Garden supported Ruinous Splendour Condition, now understood as climax aftermath, where Future Subjugation of Nature explains weedlessness as controlled life and Security Rewards Feebleness explains long neglect as loss of vigour.

changes.gist: The Traveller depicts the future as a disease-free, toilless paradise and then argues that removing hardship and danger inevitably weakens intelligence, family bonds, and passion.
The Traveller argues that humanity's total conquest of nature made strength useless, turning surplus energy into brief art before languor and contented inactivity.

revisions.old_reading: The condition of ruinous splendour is now to be understood as the aftermath of the civilising climax, where complete security removed need and left splendour without vigour to maintain it.
revisions.new_reading: The condition of ruinous splendour is now to be read as proof of perfect conquest: vast grandeur as what conquest built and ruin as what contented inactivity then allowed.
revisions.rationale: The perfect conquest idea explicitly takes vast ruins together with frailty as proof of completed conquest, adding evidential meaning to the previously puzzling ruinous splendour.

revisions.old_reading: Frail Future People are now also to be read as enfeebled by perfect security which rewarded feebleness.
revisions.new_reading: Frail future people are now also to be read as the end-point after secure energy burned briefly in art and eroticism and then sank into languor, not only as direct enfeeblement by security.
revisions.rationale: The energy decays through art claim inserts a brief artistic and erotic flowering between security and languor, adding a stage to the existing enfeeblement-by-security reading of frailty.

revisions.old_reading: Massive splendid buildings remain seen, but they no longer signify vastly superior inhabitants; childlike frail people show architectural splendour can coexist with intellectual decline.
revisions.new_reading: Glimmering Future Architecture is now also to be read as grandeur built by perfect conquest and left to ruin by contented inactivity.
revisions.rationale: Ruinous Splendour Condition is now explained by Perfect Conquest of Nature as grandeur built by conquest then ruined by inactivity, so Glimmering Future Architecture gains that origin story while still showing splendour coexisting with decline.

revisions.new_reading: Childlike Sun Thunder Question is now also to be read as illustration that Victorian restless energy become weakness left only childlike intellect.
revisions.rationale: Expected Future Superiority is now denied by Strength Becomes Weakness, so Childlike Sun Thunder Question still contradicts expectation but now also exemplifies strength turned to weakness.

revisions.old_reading: Granite Aluminium Ruin is now also to be read as splendour left derelict because security removed need and vigour to maintain it.
revisions.new_reading: Granite Aluminium Ruin is now also to be read as grandeur built by perfect conquest then left derelict after secure energy passed through art into languor.
revisions.rationale: Ruinous Splendour Condition is now proof of Perfect Conquest of Nature and Energy Decays Through Art, so Granite Aluminium Ruin keeps its derelict-splendour sense while gaining conquest-built origin and art-to-languor mechanism.

revisions.new_reading: Delicate Future People are now also to be read as the languor endpoint after secure energy burned briefly in art and eroticism, not only as directly enfeebled by security.
revisions.rationale: Frail Future People are now reinterpreted through Energy Decays Through Art as an art-to-languor endpoint, and Delicate Future People refines that frailty so inherits the longer decay sequence.

revisions.new_reading: Toilless Social Paradise is now also to be read as the perfect security that made strength useless and sent surplus energy through brief art into languor.
revisions.rationale: Ruinous Splendour Condition is now proof of Perfect Conquest of Nature, and Toilless Social Paradise specifies its splendid side, so the toilless condition gains a causal role through Strength Becomes Weakness and Energy Decays Through Art.

changes.gist: The Traveller's self-satisfied solution to the future gives way to moonlit horror and frantic panic when he discovers the Time Machine has vanished.

revisions.old_reading: The Full-size Time Machine now lies in the future garden with its starting levers unscrewed and removed.
revisions.new_reading: The Full-size Time Machine is no longer lying on the lawn by the Sphinx; it has vanished.
revisions.rationale: Time Machine Vanished reports the machine is gone, which ends the prior state of Full-size Time Machine lying in the future garden.

revisions.old_reading: The big machine remains in the future garden but now has its starting levers unscrewed and removed to prevent it being set in motion.
revisions.new_reading: The Large unfinished time machine is no longer waiting in the future garden with levers removed but has vanished from the lawn by the Sphinx with the Full-size Time Machine as shown by Time Machine Vanished.
revisions.rationale: The Full-size Time Machine refines the Large unfinished time machine as the same machine, and Time Machine Vanished establishes that machine is now gone from the lawn, so the prior remaining-in-garden state no longer holds.

changes.gist: The Traveller confirms the Time Machine is gone, concludes an unknown power hid it in space rather than time, and collapses into violent frenzy before retreating to the dark deserted hall.

revisions.new_reading: The watching smile should now be understood as mocking triumph hinting at hostile intervention, not merely curious watching at astonishment.
revisions.rationale: The moonlit mocking smile in this passage suggests the earlier watching smile was already mockery, adding hostile meaning to idle observation.

revisions.new_reading: The Colossal White Winged Statue is now understood as a mocking triumphant watcher hinting at hostile intervention like the Smiling Marble Sphinx Watcher and Mocking sphinx smile, not merely a neutral looming monument.
revisions.rationale: The Smiling Marble Sphinx Watcher refines the Colossal White Winged Statue by adding a watching smile to the looming figure, and that smile is now read as mocking triumph because the Mocking sphinx smile shows the sphinx smiling in mockery of dismay and the Unsuspected intervening power shows an unknown power made the invention vanish.

changes.gist: The Traveller angrily confronts the sleeping little people about his lost machine, recognizes his folly, then raves through a night of despair before collapsing by the sphinx until morning.
In morning daylight the Traveller recovers composure, resolves to calmly recover or rebuild his machine, and follows physical traces to infer it is hidden inside the hollow sphinx pedestal.

revisions.new_reading: He is no longer in gashed-knuckle frenzy but awake in morning freshness and able to face his situation rationally.
revisions.rationale: Morning Calm Recovery shows composure returning after the night of frenzied beating described in Bloody bush beating.

revisions.new_reading: He no longer disregards the little people but resolves to be calm and patient to learn them as part of recovering or remaking the machine.
revisions.rationale: Calm Patient Resolve explicitly commits to learning the people, replacing the earlier disregard described in Traveller Disregards Hosts.

revisions.old_reading: The Colossal White Winged Statue is now understood as a mocking triumphant watcher hinting at hostile intervention like the Smiling Marble Sphinx Watcher and Mocking sphinx smile, not merely a neutral looming monument.
revisions.new_reading: The bronze base beneath the looming white figure is also to be understood as a hollow container with door-like panels that can hide the machine, in addition to being a mocking watcher.
revisions.rationale: Hollow Bronze Pedestal reveals through rapping that the pedestal is hollow, adding a hiding-place function to Colossal White Winged Statue.

changes.gist: The Traveller's coaxing, coercion, and hammering all fail to open the sphinx pedestal against Eloi horror and bronze resistance, leaving him too restless to keep watch.

revisions.new_reading: The hollow pedestal is also to be read as a forbidden object whose opening provokes horror and insult, in addition to being a hollow container with door-like panels.
revisions.rationale: Hollow Bronze Pedestal describes the pedestal as hollow with framed panels like doors, while Eloi Horror at Request shows the Eloi treating any gesture toward opening it as a gross insult and withdrawing, adding a social prohibition to its meaning.

revisions.new_reading: The bronze pedestal remains closed, but a coil in its decoration is now flattened and verdigris has come off in powdery flakes from hammering.
revisions.rationale: Hollow Bronze Pedestal describes hollow bronze panels like doors, while Hammering Bronze Pedestal shows those panels battered with a pebble until decoration flattened and verdigris scattered without opening.

changes.gist: The Traveller resolves to stop obsessing over the sphinx, laugh at his self-made trap, and patiently learn the Eloi world and language while staying tethered near his arrival point.

The Traveller surveys a uniformly lush future landscape and investigates deep bronze-rimmed wells that throb and inhale air, inferring underground ventilation while confessing his sanitary explanation was wrong.

revisions.new_reading: The odd cupola-covered well-like structure is now to be understood as one instance of many bronze-rimmed ventilation shafts belonging to an extensive subterranean system, not an isolated oddity.
revisions.rationale: The ventilation inference shows the briefly noticed cupola-covered oddity belongs to a system of throbbing inhaling shafts.

revisions.new_reading: The confident claim to have mastered the whole secret is now to be understood as mistaken overconfidence in an obvious sanitary interpretation that is retracted as absolutely wrong.
revisions.rationale: The admission of error directly qualifies the earlier mastery claim as premature.

changes.gist: The Traveller excuses his ignorance of future infrastructure by comparing himself to an incomprehending visitor, then notes the puzzling absence of tombs and of any aged or infirm people.
The Traveller admits his early theories collapse under unsolved puzzles of upkeep and disappearance, then recounts rescuing a drowning little person while the others do nothing.

revisions.new_reading: The impression of automatic organisation is now to be understood as a provisional first theory that the Traveller has abandoned as unsatisfying, not a retained conclusion.
revisions.rationale: Failed First Theories explicitly says the automatic civilisation theorizing did not last, so the earlier general impression can no longer stand as his view.

changes.gist: The Traveller names the rescued little woman Weena and recounts their childlike, clinging week-long friendship that makes his return to the White Sphinx feel like coming home.

revisions.old_reading: He no longer disregards the little people but resolves to be calm and patient to learn them as part of recovering or remaking the machine.
revisions.new_reading: He no longer disregards the little people but cherishes Weena's clinging fondness, watches for her, and feels returning to the White Sphinx neighbourhood almost like coming home.
revisions.rationale: The coming-home image and week-long friendship show disregard has turned into personal attachment and home feeling centred on Weena.

changes.gist: The passage establishes Weena and the Eloi's passionate fear of darkness and huddled night-sleep, the Traveller's failure to heed it, and his eerie pre-dawn waking that sends him out to watch the sunrise.

revisions.new_reading: The cushioned hall of sleepers should now be understood not as casual rest but as the fear-driven nightly huddle against darkness.
revisions.rationale: Eloi Huddle After Dark reveals gathering to sleep in droves as a general habit after dark, which adds motive to Cushioned sleeping hall.

changes.gist: The Traveller glimpses hasty white ape-like figures carrying a dark burden at dawn, dismisses them as ghosts, yet remains haunted with foreboding.

revisions.new_reading: The fancy of a greyish animal rushing from the chamber should now be understood as likely a real glimpse of the same hasty white creatures seen at dawn, not mere dream-confusion.
revisions.rationale: Repeated sightings of fast white figures that vanish make the earlier fleeting intruder seem like the same kind of being.

revisions.new_reading: The belief that fear is forgotten should now be read as true only of daylight behaviour; dawn apparitions and lingering foreboding show dread persists beyond daylight.
revisions.rationale: Haunting foreboding after seeing carriers at dawn directly qualifies the earlier daylight-based generalization.

revisions.new_reading: Perfect Conquest of Nature should now be read as a daylight-only illusion undermined by persisting dread beyond daylight.
revisions.rationale: Fear forgotten belief now holds only for daylight behaviour while Foreboding deadlier possession shows haunting dread persists, removing the support for a completed conquest.

revisions.new_reading: Absence of burial signs should now be read as pointing to hidden disposal of the dead by the burden-carrying white creatures rather than absence of death.
revisions.rationale: No aged or infirm is contradicted by Leash carrying dark body implying injury or death, making the lack of tombs an ominous gap filled by the white creatures.

revisions.new_reading: Gibbous Moon Rising should now be read as the nightly onset of fearful hours confirmed by dawn apparitions rather than mere picturesque nightfall.
revisions.rationale: Fear forgotten belief is now limited to daylight while Foreboding deadlier possession and Ghastly dawn half-light show dread surrounding night and dawn, giving the moonrise foreboding significance.

changes.gist: The Traveller speculates that a hotter sun explains the future climate, then recounts entering a dark ruined gallery where luminous eyes watched him and a small ape-like creature fled into shadow.
The Traveller chases the pale creature to a well shaft, watches it climb down a ladder, and concludes humanity has split into two distinct species.

revisions.old_reading: The odd cupola-covered well-like structure is now to be understood as one instance of many bronze-rimmed ventilation shafts belonging to an extensive subterranean system, not an isolated oddity.
revisions.new_reading: The cupola-covered well is an inhabited access shaft with a ladder used by the pale creatures to move between surface and below, not only a ventilation shaft.
revisions.rationale: Seeing the creature retreat down the shaft shows the wells are thoroughfares for the subterranean inhabitants.

revisions.old_reading: Delicate Future People are now also to be read as the languor endpoint after secure energy burned briefly in art and eroticism, not only as directly enfeebled by security.
revisions.new_reading: The delicate Dresden-china people are only the surface branch of a humanity now split into two distinct species, still showing enfeeblement after security but no longer taken as the whole of humanity.
revisions.rationale: The split claim requires the frail surface dwellers previously taken for all future people to be reread as one of two animals alongside the pale nocturnal creatures.

revisions.new_reading: Humanity upon the wane is now to be understood as differentiation into two distinct species, not simple decline of a single humanity.
revisions.rationale: Concluding that humanity split into two distinct animals qualifies the earlier perception of general decline.

revisions.new_reading: The Bronze-rimmed circular wells are now to be read as inhabited access shafts with ladders used by the pale branch to move between surface and below, not only as ventilation shafts.
revisions.rationale: Well Under Cupola was revised by Well Shaft Sighting from only ventilation to inhabited access with a ladder, and since Bronze-rimmed circular wells refines Well Under Cupola, the same addition applies, supported by Shaft Ladder Rests.

revisions.old_reading: Frail Future People are now also to be read as enfeebled by perfect security which rewarded feebleness.
revisions.new_reading: The Frail Future People are now to be read as only the surface branch of a humanity split into two species, still frail from security but no longer the whole of humanity.
revisions.rationale: Delicate Future People refines Frail Future People and was reframed by Humanity Split Species from all humanity to only one surface branch, so the frailty account must be scoped the same way.

revisions.old_reading: The fear that future men became cruel and overwhelmingly powerful now looks misplaced; the encountered future people present as slight, beautiful and frail rather than as an overwhelming threat.
revisions.new_reading: The fear that Future humanity turned cruel can no longer be dismissed as misplaced from surface frailty alone now that Humanity Split Species leaves a second underground branch still to be judged.
revisions.rationale: Humanity Upon the Wane was revised by Humanity Split Species from decline of a single humanity to differentiation into two, so the contradiction with Future humanity turned cruel no longer disposes of cruelty, especially with Pale Nocturnal Creature still unassessed.

changes.gist: The Traveller doubts his balanced-utopia theory, fears descending the well, notes the Overworlders' refusal to acknowledge it, and senses a unified explanation for wells, ghosts, and the missing Time Machine emerging.

revisions.new_reading: The extensive ventilation arrangement should now be understood as a provisional surface account suspected of concealing a deeper true import.
revisions.rationale: The doubt explicitly says the ventilation idea may hide its true import, which adds a layer of suspicion without denying the shafts exist.

revisions.old_reading: The odd cupola-covered well-like structure is now to be understood as one instance of many bronze-rimmed ventilation shafts belonging to an extensive subterranean system, not an isolated oddity.
revisions.new_reading: The cupola-covered well should now be read as one node in a unified puzzle connecting wells, ventilating towers, ghostly appearances, bronze gates and the missing machine, not only as a ventilation shaft.
revisions.rationale: The clue explicitly groups the wells with those other phenomena, which expands what the well signifies without denying its physical description.

revisions.new_reading: The throbbing inhaling shaft test should now be read as a physical trace of deeper inhabited activity feeding the unified puzzle, not only as evidence for ventilation.
revisions.rationale: The Throbbing inhaling shaft test gave physical evidence for the Subterranean ventilation system, but the Ventilation true import doubt now treats that ventilation arrangement as a provisional surface account, while the Emerging unified explanation clue repositions wells and ventilating towers inside a larger mystery.

revisions.old_reading: The Bronze-rimmed circular wells are now to be read as inhabited access shafts with ladders used by the pale branch to move between surface and below, not only as ventilation shafts.
revisions.new_reading: The bronze-rimmed circular wells should now be read as nodes in the unified puzzle linking wells, towers, ghosts, bronze gates and the missing machine while remaining inhabited access shafts.
revisions.rationale: The Bronze-rimmed circular wells develops the Well Under Cupola, and the Well Under Cupola is now to be understood as one node in a unified puzzle from the Emerging unified explanation clue, so the detailed wells must inherit that wider role in addition to remaining inhabited access shafts.

revisions.new_reading: The well shaft sighting should now be read as the unassimilable Lemur encounter that breaks the balanced-organization scheme and supplies the unified clue, as well as proof of habitation.
revisions.rationale: The Well Shaft Sighting showed habitation in the Well Under Cupola, but the Lemur balance scheme puzzle now makes that creature the anomaly that the Automatic organisation impression cannot accommodate, and the Emerging unified explanation clue makes wells plus ghosts part of one puzzle.

changes.gist: The Traveller proposes that the ape-like creatures are a light-sensitive subterranean race that does the daylight race's work, originating in the widened divide between Capitalist and Labourer driven underground by industry.

revisions.new_reading: Absence by day and appearance as creatures of half-light should now be understood as daytime retreat underground by a light-sensitive race, not as insubstantiality.
revisions.rationale: The theory of retinal pain and subterranean habit shows the earlier daylight absence reflects avoidance of sunshine, making the ghost dismissal mistaken.

revisions.new_reading: Ventilation shafts are now to be understood as airways for an inhabited artificial Underworld that houses the subterranean race and its work, resolving the earlier suspicion of a hidden import.
revisions.rationale: The tunnelling claim answers the earlier doubt about ventilation by identifying the true import as a populated underworld.

revisions.old_reading: Frail Future People are now also to be read as enfeebled by perfect security which rewarded feebleness.
revisions.new_reading: The slight beautiful frail people are now also to be understood as descendants of the Capitalist upper branch maintained by underground labour, in addition to being enfeebled by security.
revisions.rationale: The class-split key gives a social ancestry to the earlier frail surface branch now known to be only half of split humanity.

revisions.new_reading: White figures on hill are now to be read as real surface forays of the light-sensitive subterranean race rather than insubstantial half-light apparitions.
revisions.rationale: Dismissal as ghosts is revised from insubstantiality to daytime retreat underground, while Subterranean Second Species establishes a plainly subterranean race and Extreme Retinal Sensitivity proves light-driven retreat, so White figures on hill can no longer stand as denied apparitions.

revisions.old_reading: The extensive ventilation arrangement should now be understood as a provisional surface account suspected of concealing a deeper true import.
revisions.new_reading: Subterranean ventilation system is now to be read as airways for an inhabited artificial Underworld housing the subterranean race and its labour rather than mere ventilation.
revisions.rationale: Ventilation true import doubt suspected a hidden import behind ventilation, and Tunnelled Underground Habitat plus Underworld Labour Service resolve it as an enormously tunnelled habitat where work for the daylight race is done, so Subterranean ventilation system is no longer provisional.

revisions.old_reading: Delicate Future People are now also to be read as the languor endpoint after secure energy burned briefly in art and eroticism, not only as directly enfeebled by security.
revisions.new_reading: Delicate Future People are now also to be read as the Capitalist-descended surface branch maintained by hidden underground labour while remaining the languor endpoint.
revisions.rationale: Frail Future People are now also descendants of the Capitalist upper branch, and Capitalist-Labourer Split Key plus Underworld Labour Service give that branch its split origin and maintenance, which refines Delicate Future People as the same surface people without replacing languor.

revisions.old_reading: The fear that future men became cruel and overwhelmingly powerful now looks misplaced; the encountered future people present as slight, beautiful and frail rather than as an overwhelming threat.
revisions.new_reading: Future humanity turned cruel is now to be read as no longer dismissible as misplaced because the overwhelming threat may reside in the subterranean second branch rather than the frail surface people.
revisions.rationale: Future humanity turned cruel looked misplaced against Frail Future People, but Frail Future People are now only the surface branch while Subterranean Second Species and Capitalist-Labourer Split Key establish a second underground branch still to be judged.

revisions.old_reading: Perfect Conquest of Nature should now be read as a daylight-only illusion undermined by persisting dread beyond daylight.
revisions.new_reading: Perfect Conquest of Nature is now also to be read as a daylight illusion sustained by hidden underground labour for the Capitalist-descended surface branch rather than true conquest.
revisions.rationale: Perfect Conquest of Nature already stood as a daylight-only illusion, and Frail Future People becoming Capitalist descendants plus Underworld Labour Service and Capitalist-Labourer Split Key now supply the hidden labour mechanism that sustains the illusion.

changes.gist: The Traveller completes his theory that class stratification split humanity into pleasure-seeking Haves above and labour-adapted Have-nots below, then reframes humanity's triumph as aristocratic domination over nature and men now decayed into Overworlder degeneration.

revisions.old_reading: Ventilation shafts are now to be understood as airways for an inhabited artificial Underworld that houses the subterranean race and its work, resolving the earlier suspicion of a hidden import.
revisions.new_reading: Ventilation shafts are now also to be read as instruments of economic coercion where underground dwellers pay rent for air or face starvation and suffocation.
revisions.rationale: Rent For Underground Air adds that ventilation involves heavy rent with starvation or suffocation for arrears, deepening the earlier suspicion of a hidden import beyond mere airways.

revisions.old_reading: Perfect Conquest of Nature should now be read as a daylight-only illusion undermined by persisting dread beyond daylight.
revisions.new_reading: Perfect conquest should now also be read as an aristocratic domination carrying the present industrial system to its conclusion, not a moral or cooperative triumph over nature.
revisions.rationale: Aristocratic Triumph Over Fellow-Man reframes the triumph behind splendid buildings and frail people as domination by an aristocracy armed with perfected science.

revisions.new_reading: The civilising climax is now to be understood as passed, with balanced civilisation past its zenith and sunk into degeneration.
revisions.rationale: Overworlder Degeneration In Decay says balanced civilisation has passed its zenith, so the steady advance to a climax described in Civilising Amelioration Climax now leads onward to decline.

revisions.old_reading: Subterranean ventilation system is now to be read as airways for an inhabited artificial Underworld housing the subterranean race and its labour rather than mere ventilation.
revisions.new_reading: Subterranean ventilation system is now also to be read as a rent-extraction apparatus enforcing the Haves Above Workers Below split, in addition to airways for an inhabited Underworld.
revisions.rationale: Ventilation true import doubt is now also read through Rent For Underground Air as coercive rent for air, so Subterranean ventilation system as the concrete ventilation arrangement gains that economic-coercive significance while remaining airways for underground labour.

revisions.new_reading: Future Subjugation of Nature is now to be read as a mistaken cooperative ideal exposed as Aristocratic Triumph Over Fellow-Man rather than a future moral reshaping of life.
revisions.rationale: Future Subjugation of Nature predicts wisely cooperative readjustment of life, while Aristocratic Triumph Over Fellow-Man denies moral cooperation and Perfect Conquest of Nature is reframed as aristocratic domination, so the cooperative expectation no longer holds as stated.

revisions.new_reading: Tunnelled Underground Habitat is now also to be read as rented caverns for which the Workers pay ventilation rent, in addition to habitat of the New Race.
revisions.rationale: Tunnelled Underground Habitat gives concrete form to Ventilation true import doubt, and Ventilation true import doubt now includes Rent For Underground Air where caverns require heavy rent for ventilation, so the habitat gains that rented-coercive meaning while remaining habitat.

changes.gist: The Traveller suspects the Morlocks stole his machine but delays descending for two days, blocked by Weena's tearful horror, his own revulsion at the Morlocks, and lonely dread as dark moonless nights approach.

revisions.new_reading: The moon is no longer gibbous and bright; it is waning toward its last quarter with nights growing dark.
revisions.rationale: Gibbous illumination described earlier has passed; passage explicitly says the moon must pass through last quarter and nights grow dark.

changes.gist: The Traveller spots the Palace of Green Porcelain, recognizes his interest as an excuse to delay, and climbs down the Morlock well despite Weena's anguished protest.

revisions.new_reading: The deadlock of must descend yet afraid to go is over; he has committed to and begun the descent into the well.
revisions.rationale: The earlier Resolve versus fear situation left him afraid to go, while this passage resolve and entry show him climbing down despite fear and Weena's protest.

revisions.new_reading: Traveller's Lonely Paralysis is ended when Resolve for Immediate Descent overcomes horror to produce Entry Into Well Throat.
revisions.rationale: Traveller's Lonely Paralysis meant being appalled by horrid aloneness into inaction, while Resolve versus fear now records the deadlock as over and Resolve for Immediate Descent followed by Entry Into Well Throat show him acting despite fear, so the fact of paralysis has passed in time without changing what the horror meant.

changes.gist: The passage narrates the Traveller's painful and terrifying climb down the Morlock shaft to a side tunnel refuge as his visual link to Weena and the surface disappears.
The passage narrates the Traveller's awakening among light-fleeing Morlocks and his fearful exploration of their vast machine-filled cavern with signs of bloody meat-eating.
The Traveller confesses his naive unpreparedness and recounts being groped, mocked, and chased by Morlocks in the dark as his matches run out.

revisions.new_reading: Expected Future Superiority should now be understood as a naive absurd assumption about inevitable progress, not as a reasonable forecast.
revisions.rationale: The confession of absurd assumption shows the earlier expectation of vast superiority was naive, changing how that expectation should be understood.

revisions.new_reading: The chuckle stirring inside the pedestal should now be understood as real Morlock mocking laughter, not a mistake, anticipating the mocking pursuit in the dark.
revisions.rationale: Chuckle Inside Pedestal was dismissed as mistaken, but the current account of being mocked and chased in the dark by Morlocks suggests such laughter was real.

revisions.new_reading: Time Machine Built Vain should now be understood as disappointment caused by the collapse of Expected Future Superiority now exposed as Absurd future progress assumption.
revisions.rationale: Expected Future Superiority was revised from reasonable forecast to naive absurd assumption because of Absurd future progress assumption, so the feeling in Time Machine Built Vain is now understood as self-inflicted by that absurd expectation rather than as objective proof that time travel was worthless.

changes.gist: The Traveller fights off the Morlocks clutching him in the dark, endures a sickening climb up the shaft, and collapses into sunlight where Weena and the Eloi comfort him before he loses consciousness.

revisions.new_reading: He has now acted on the resisted impulse and climbed rapidly up the shaft to escape the Morlocks, leaving the Underworld.
revisions.rationale: Retreat Impulse Resisted said he considered climbing back up but kept descending; Violent Shaft Escape shows he now does climb up to escape seizure.

revisions.new_reading: Enduring Fear of Darkness should now also be read as well-founded dread of being seized by Morlocks in the dark, with sunlight and Eloi companionship as relief.
revisions.rationale: Enduring Fear of Darkness spoke of fear concentrated in darkness; the fight with clutching hands in the dark and collapse into sunlight tended by Weena and the Eloi reveals what that darkness holds.

revisions.new_reading: Traveller Missed The Lesson now also reads as his failure to grasp that fear of darkness meant literal danger of being seized by Morlocks.
revisions.rationale: Enduring Fear of Darkness is now well-founded dread of being seized in the dark, and Morlocks Haul Traveller Back shows hands clutching to haul him back, so Traveller Missed The Lesson gains concrete validation as missing that specific predatory danger.

changes.gist: The Traveller despairs as hope fails, dreads the coming moonless nights, and revises his theory to cast the decayed Eloi as doomed prey to the rising Morlocks.

revisions.old_reading: Frail Future People are now also to be read as enfeebled by perfect security which rewarded feebleness.
revisions.new_reading: The slight beautiful frail beings should now also be understood as decaying doomed prey whose former servants are creeping on as their nemesis in a reversed class order.
revisions.rationale: Reversed Class Evolution explicitly casts the delicate ones as decaying prey to a rising nemesis, adding doom to earlier readings of enfeeblement by security.

revisions.old_reading: Delicate Future People are now also to be read as the languor endpoint after secure energy burned briefly in art and eroticism, not only as directly enfeebled by security.
revisions.new_reading: The Delicate Future People are now also to be understood as decaying doomed prey whose former servants are creeping on as their nemesis.
revisions.rationale: Because Delicate Future People refines Frail Future People, the new Frail Future People understanding as doomed prey transfers directly, and Reversed Class Evolution states the Nemesis of the delicate ones was creeping on apace.

changes.gist: The Traveller resolves to arm himself and secure a refuge, then carries Weena on a long lame trek toward the Palace of Green Porcelain, arriving after sunset.

revisions.new_reading: The resolve for immediate descent no longer holds; his present resolve is to make arms and secure a sleeping fastness first.
revisions.rationale: Resolve for Immediate Descent committed to descending without waste of time, but Resolve for arms replaces it with arming and securing refuge before acting.

changes.gist: The Traveller silently displays two withered flowers, then narrates carrying the exhausted, frightened Weena through deepening dusk toward the Palace while dreading the Morlocks below.

Blocked by a dark wood and exhausted, the Traveller decides to spend the night on the open hill with the sleeping Weena while observing a strangely changed but comforting night sky as he waits for moonrise.
Under the stars the Traveller grasps the total erasure of humanity and recoils from a horrible insight about the Morlocks' meat, then endures a peaceful night to dawn and discards his ruined shoes.

revisions.old_reading: Humanity upon the wane is now to be understood as differentiation into two distinct species, not simple decline of a single humanity.
revisions.new_reading: Humanity upon the wane should now also be understood as total erasure where all human activity and memory have been swept out of existence, leaving only frail creatures.
revisions.rationale: The civilization-swept-into-oblivion claim turns a gradual wane into a completed sweep out of existence.

revisions.new_reading: The unplaced memory of meat seen in the Underworld should now be understood as a shivering realization that the meat was likely the flesh of the frail prey species.
revisions.rationale: The horrible realization about meat resolves the previously unplaced intrusive memory into a specific dread about what was seen.

revisions.new_reading: The Morlocks' carnivorousness is now to be understood as feeding upon the frail surface people.
revisions.rationale: Underworld Meat Memory left the meat as an outside question supporting Morlocks are meat-eaters, but Horrible Realization About Meat gives shivering insight into what that meat might be, and Civilization Swept Into Oblivion identifies the replacement population as frail creatures, so the carnivorous claim now points to predation on the other human branch.

changes.gist: The Traveller names the Morlocks' meat as the Eloi and tries scientific detachment and moral-retribution explanations before admitting the Eloi's retained humanity makes sympathetic horror unavoidable.

revisions.new_reading: The wood is now green and pleasant in morning light, approachable for fruit gathering, not black and forbidding.
revisions.rationale: Morning Fruit Foray shows the same wood under morning light as green and pleasant, changing the facts of Thick Wood Barrier's forbidding description.

revisions.old_reading: Frail Future People are now also to be read as enfeebled by perfect security which rewarded feebleness.
revisions.new_reading: Frail Future People remain slight and frail and preyed upon, but are also still recognizably human whose form compels sympathy, so they cannot be regarded with detachment as mere cattle.
revisions.rationale: Inescapable Human Sympathy shows the attempt to see the Eloi as cattle collapses because their human form demands sympathy, adding a sympathetic-humanity layer to Frail Future People.

revisions.old_reading: Delicate Future People are now also to be read as the languor endpoint after secure energy burned briefly in art and eroticism, not only as directly enfeebled by security.
revisions.new_reading: Delicate Future People remain delicate Dresden-china pretty beings but are also still recognizably human whose form compels sympathy so they cannot be regarded with detachment as mere cattle.
revisions.rationale: Delicate Future People refines Frail Future People, and Frail Future People now adds Inescapable Human Sympathy which defeats Eloi As Cattle detachment, so the delicate Dresden-china description must also carry that sympathetic-human block on cattle detachment in addition to its languor endpoint reading.

changes.gist: The Traveller lays out his immediate plans for refuge, weapons, fire, and forcing the bronze doors to recover the Time Machine with Weena, then describes arriving at the ruined Palace of Green Porcelain and observing Weena's non-literate humanity.

revisions.new_reading: His sustaining hope is renewed in conditional form: he now believes forcing the bronze doors with light may recover the Time Machine and allow escape.
revisions.rationale: The shattered hope account says his sustaining hope of escape was staggered, while the light entry escape belief lays out a plan to discover the Time Machine and escape, showing hope has returned.

changes.gist: The Traveller enters a dusty fossil gallery, recognizes it as a decayed future museum, and notes slow decay and Morlock disturbance while Weena stays close.
The Traveller explores further museum galleries for useful knowledge, noting decayed natural history and a vast hall of corroded machines that might yield power against the Morlocks.
As the museum gallery slopes into darkness, the Traveller senses nearby Morlocks and snaps off a machine lever to arm himself while confessing a longing to kill them.
Moving from a decayed library that evokes wasted intellectual labour to a preserved chemistry gallery, the Traveller finds dry matches and celebrates gaining a weapon against the Morlocks.
Continuing his museum scavenging, the Traveller pockets improbably preserved camphor for light, finds firearms useless without powder, and idly signs a foreign idol.
The Traveller's joy over found dynamite collapses when it proves dummy, so after resting in a palace court he resolves to camp out by fire and force the bronze doors in the morning.
The Traveller's late push toward the White Sphinx stalls through exhaustion and nightfall, and with pursuers closing in he drops his gathered fuel to burn it as cover.

revisions.new_reading: The hilltop immunity has ended; three pursuers now crouch in the black bushes behind the pair as night falls.
revisions.rationale: The earlier absence of attackers was true of that hill vigil, but the appearance of three crouching figures shows pursuers now closing in.

changes.gist: The Traveller muses on fire's strangeness to this future, restrains the fascinated Weena, flees carrying her into the dark wood as his fire spreads, and is caught up by closing Morlocks.

revisions.old_reading: The wood is now green and pleasant in morning light, approachable for fruit gathering, not black and forbidding.
revisions.new_reading: The Thick Wood Barrier is again a black night wood that Armed flight into darkness enters and where Morlocks seize Traveller closes in.
revisions.rationale: Thick Wood Barrier caused Open Hill Overnight Decision to avoid the dark wood, but Armed flight into darkness shows plunging into the black wood and Morlocks seize Traveller shows the wood is again black, forbidding and occupied, overturning the green pleasant morning reading.

revisions.old_reading: The hilltop immunity has ended; three pursuers now crouch in the black bushes behind the pair as night falls.
revisions.new_reading: The Night Without Morlock Attack immunity has ended into active assault as Armed flight into darkness abandons the hill and Morlocks seize Traveller grabs coat and arm.
revisions.rationale: Night Without Morlock Attack was caused by Open Hill Overnight Decision to stay on the open hill, but Armed flight into darkness shows that hill stay abandoned and Morlocks seize Traveller shows crouching watch escalated to physical seizure, so mere absence of attack no longer holds.

revisions.new_reading: The Long trek with Weena paused by Open Hill Overnight Decision has resumed as Armed flight into darkness carrying Weena into the wood and is now halted by Morlocks seize Traveller.
revisions.rationale: Open Hill Overnight Decision paused Long trek with Weena, but Armed flight into darkness shows carrying Weena again into the black wood while Morlocks seize Traveller shows that resumed carrying now caught by pursuers.

changes.gist: The Traveller beats off a close Morlock grapple with match and camphor, finds Weena collapsed, discovers he has lost his direction, and resolves to camp and make a fire while surrounded.
The Traveller builds a smoky fire beside apparently lifeless Weena, dozes off, wakes to Morlocks seizing him with his matches gone, and beats them back with his iron bar.

revisions.new_reading: Weena now lies beside the iron mace like one dead and cannot be revived.
revisions.rationale: The earlier motionless-Weena situation had her fainted but scarcely breathing; the present lifeless lying shows attempts to revive her now fail.

revisions.new_reading: The box of dry matches found in the chemistry gallery is now gone, lost while Morlocks cling to him.
revisions.rationale: The earlier dry-matches discovery established possession of the box; the present match-box loss shows it has vanished from his pocket.

revisions.new_reading: The iron bar hoped to force the bronze doors is also to be read as an effective melee weapon that can beat Morlocks back and fight free.
revisions.rationale: The earlier door-forcing plan valued the bar only for the bronze doors; the present counterattack shows the same lever used in hand-to-hand fighting.

revisions.new_reading: The protective blaze counted in Fire Against Morlocks can no longer use matches because the match-box is gone.
revisions.rationale: Fire Against Morlocks counts matches and camphor as means for a protective blaze, but Losing the match-box shows the box had gone while Dry matches discovery now records that box as lost, so the matches means no longer exists though the plan means the same.

changes.gist: The Traveller's hopeless stand against the Morlocks turns when he realizes his earlier campfire has become a raging forest fire that routs the Morlocks, loses him Weena, and forces his own flight through the flames.

revisions.new_reading: The encampment fire is no longer a controlled campfire but a raging forest fire advancing through the trees.
revisions.rationale: Decision to Encamp built a fire to encamp, now Forest Fire Realization shows that fire grown into an advancing burning forest.

revisions.new_reading: Weena is no longer beside the Traveller holding his hand; she has vanished amid the fire.
revisions.rationale: Weena Takes Hand had her standing beside him, now Weena Disappears has her gone when looked for.

revisions.new_reading: The fire made in Building smoky bonfire is no longer a controlled choking campfire but part of the raging forest fire advancing through the trees.
revisions.rationale: Decision to Encamp is now a raging forest fire rather than a controlled campfire, and Forest Fire Realization shows the flames of the burning forest advancing behind, so the fire built in Building smoky bonfire has changed in physical state while its original economizing purpose is unchanged.

revisions.new_reading: The Traveller is no longer holding Weena after the Armed exit with Weena, because she has vanished amid the fire.
revisions.rationale: Armed exit with Weena continued the protective contact begun in Weena Takes Hand, and Weena Disappears shows she was gone when looked for amid the fire, so the ongoing holding state no longer obtains while the past exit itself is unchanged.

changes.gist: The Traveller finds himself in a fire-encircled clearing watching dazzled Morlocks grope helplessly, attacks them in fear then spares them, and discovers Weena is gone.

The Traveller endures the burning night in disbelieving anguish, accepts Weena's disappearance with mingled relief and grief at dawn, and limps toward the Time Machine overwhelmed by loneliness and homesickness.
Returning to his first overlook with leftover matches, the Traveller recognizes the Eloi's beauty as a cattle-like existence produced by humanity's self-destructive pursuit of perfect security.

revisions.old_reading: The protective blaze counted in Fire Against Morlocks can no longer use matches because the match-box is gone.
revisions.new_reading: The protective blaze can still be made in limited form with loose matches and camphor, though the match-box is gone.
revisions.rationale: Loose Matches Discovery shows matches still held, against the earlier view that the protective blaze could no longer use matches because the box was gone.

revisions.old_reading: Frail Future People are now also to be read as enfeebled by perfect security which rewarded feebleness.
revisions.new_reading: Slight beautiful graceful frail beings are also to be understood as living a pleasant heedless cattle-like existence ending as prey.
revisions.rationale: Eloi as Unwary Cattle identifies beauty with pleasant heedless cattle existence ending as prey, deepening the picture of slight beautiful frail beings enfeebled by security.

revisions.old_reading: Massive splendid buildings remain seen, but they no longer signify vastly superior inhabitants; childlike frail people show architectural splendour can coexist with intellectual decline.
revisions.new_reading: Massive splendid buildings are also to be read as relics of an intellect that destroyed itself by pursuing comfort, ease and a permanent secure balanced society.
revisions.rationale: Comfort-Seeking Intellectual Suicide explains decline through comfort-seeking permanency, adding cause for splendid architecture coexisting with frail minds.

revisions.old_reading: Delicate Future People are now also to be read as the languor endpoint after secure energy burned briefly in art and eroticism, not only as directly enfeebled by security.
revisions.new_reading: Delicate Future People are also to be understood as living a pleasant heedless cattle-like existence ending as prey.
revisions.rationale: Delicate Future People refines Frail Future People, so the new cattle-like understanding of Frail Future People applies to the Dresden-china description, as stated in Eloi as Unwary Cattle.

changes.gist: The Traveller theorizes that perfect security destroyed intelligence, leaving the Upperworld feeble and the Underworld mechanical until food failure drove the latter to eat the former, then he falls asleep in the sun.

revisions.new_reading: Pain and necessity are no longer finally broken everywhere; after thousands of years necessity has returned below.
revisions.rationale: Necessity Returns Below states Mother Necessity returned below when feeding became disjointed, so Broken Grindstone of Necessity no longer holds everywhere.

changes.gist: The Traveller finds the Sphinx open with his Time Machine restored inside, knowingly walks into the Morlocks' trap, and is sealed in the dark with unusable matches.

revisions.old_reading: The bronze pedestal remains closed, but a coil in its decoration is now flattened and verdigris has come off in powdery flakes from hammering.
revisions.new_reading: The bronze pedestal valves now stand open.
revisions.rationale: The valves were found open, so the pedestal can no longer be treated as remaining closed.

revisions.new_reading: The Time Machine is no longer missing from the lawn but is recovered waiting inside the Sphinx.
revisions.rationale: The machine found inside shows the disappearance from the lawn has ended.

revisions.new_reading: The night with no Morlocks on the hill should now also be understood as deliberate holding back as part of a baiting trap, not mere absence.
revisions.rationale: The belief that the Morlocks are baiting him gives the earlier quiet night a new significance as luring.

revisions.old_reading: The bronze pedestal valves now stand open.
revisions.new_reading: The bronze pedestal is now slammed shut with the Traveller sealed in darkness inside.
revisions.rationale: Panels first found open then slammed shut, so the pedestal is now sealed with the Traveller inside in darkness.

revisions.new_reading: The loose matches in the trouser pocket should now also be understood as strike-on-box kind effectively useless without the box.
revisions.rationale: The loose matches remain in the pocket but their significance changes to useless without the box.

revisions.old_reading: The Full-size Time Machine is no longer lying on the lawn by the Sphinx; it has vanished.
revisions.new_reading: The Full-size Time Machine is no longer vanished from the lawn but recovered waiting inside the Sphinx as shown by Recovered Time Machine Inside.
revisions.rationale: Time Machine Vanished now ends in Recovered Time Machine Inside waiting in the Sphinx, so the same machine described by Full-size Time Machine has moved from absent to present without changing what it is.

revisions.new_reading: Losing the match-box is now a total loss of fire-making power because Useless Matches Crisis makes Loose Matches Discovery unusable without the box.
revisions.rationale: Loose Matches Discovery once made Losing the match-box seem partial, but Useless Matches Crisis shows those loose matches light only on the lost box, turning the loss into total helplessness.

revisions.old_reading: The protective blaze can still be made in limited form with loose matches and camphor, though the match-box is gone.
revisions.new_reading: Fire Against Morlocks protection is now unavailable because Useless Matches Crisis leaves Loose Matches Discovery unlightable without the box.
revisions.rationale: Loose Matches Discovery once supported Fire Against Morlocks in limited form, but Useless Matches Crisis shows those matches need the lost box, so the defence can no longer be used.

changes.gist: The Traveller fights off the Morlocks to engage his machine, is hurled far forward in time by mistake, and watches the sun swell red and halt as Earth becomes tidally locked before stopping at a desolate beach.

revisions.new_reading: The starting levers are no longer removed and safekept; they have been fixed back onto the machine and pulled for escape.
revisions.rationale: The passage shows the disabled condition being undone when the lever is fixed and used, changing present facts while leaving the earlier removal true of its own time.

revisions.new_reading: The dials no longer stand at 802,701; they are spinning rapidly onward into far deeper futurity.
revisions.rationale: The spinning thousands hand shows the earlier recorded date has been surpassed, changing the present dial reading while leaving the earlier reading true of its time.

revisions.new_reading: The sun is now huge, red and motionless on the horizon, beyond merely being hotter than in the traveller's own time.
revisions.rationale: Vast forward travel carries the sun past the hotter stage to a red halted stage, changing what is now the case while the hotter description stays true of its earlier age.

revisions.old_reading: The Large unfinished time machine is no longer waiting in the future garden with levers removed but has vanished from the lawn by the Sphinx with the Full-size Time Machine as shown by Time Machine Vanished.
revisions.new_reading: The time machine is no longer at 802,701 but has been carried far onward into deeper futurity.
revisions.rationale: Machine's Far Future Date no longer stands at 802,701 because Rush Into Deep Futurity shows the thousands hand sweeping onward, carrying the Large unfinished time machine beyond its prior date.

revisions.old_reading: The alternating black night and bright day no longer flickers distinctly but has merged into one continuous greyness with a deep blue sky at higher speed.
revisions.new_reading: The day-night flicker no longer merges into continuous greyness but has halted entirely with the sun motionless on the horizon.
revisions.rationale: Merged Continuous Greyness had turned Accelerating Day-Night Flicker into continuous greyness, but Motionless Red Sun shows the sun stopped and halted motionless, ending the alternation altogether.

changes.gist: The Traveller surveys a desolate far-future beach under a motionless red sun and encounters giant strange creatures.

revisions.new_reading: The sun no longer hops across the sky; it hangs huge, red and motionless on the horizon.
revisions.rationale: The new beach view shows a motionless sun, ending the earlier hopping regime.

revisions.new_reading: The machine is no longer overturned on soft turf; it now stands on a sloping beach beside a windless sea in the far future.
revisions.rationale: The new beach account gives the machine's present whereabouts after further travel.

revisions.new_reading: The Traveller is no longer in the Hail Beaten Garden Lawn but now stands with his machine on the Sloping Salt-Edged Beach.
revisions.rationale: The Hail Beaten Garden Lawn specifies the place of Stunned Turf Landing, and Stunned Turf Landing is now revised to the machine standing on the Sloping Salt-Edged Beach, so the garden sojourn is left in the past while the meaning is the same.

revisions.old_reading: The helpless unpleasant headlong feeling has faded and merged into hysterical exhilaration as the rush into futurity continues.
revisions.new_reading: The Unpleasant Headlong Sensation has now ceased entirely with the machine at rest on the Sloping Salt-Edged Beach under the Motionless Red Sun Sky.
revisions.rationale: The Unpleasant Headlong Sensation described ongoing helpless motion, but Stunned Turf Landing now places the machine at rest on the Sloping Salt-Edged Beach under the Motionless Red Sun Sky, so the motion fact has ended while the meaning is unchanged.

changes.gist: The Traveller escapes a rear crab attack with a short time jump, then travels in ever-longer strides millions of years forward as the sun swells, the crabs vanish, and freezing snow begins.

revisions.new_reading: The huge red motionless sun is now even larger and duller after thousand-year forward strides.
revisions.rationale: This passage's sun watching describes the sun growing larger and duller in the westward sky during the onward journey, updating the earlier image of the huge red motionless sun.

revisions.new_reading: By more than thirty million years on the monstrous crabs are gone and the red beach is lifeless and flecked with white.
revisions.rationale: This passage's lifeless snow situation says the crawling multitude of crabs had disappeared, changing the earlier presence of the monstrous crab creature from a current threat to a past phase.

revisions.new_reading: The split sky persists but its motionless red sun is now even larger and duller.
revisions.rationale: Motionless Red Sun Sky refines Motionless Red Sun, and Millennia-Long Sun Watching shows that same sun growing larger and duller, so the sky's sun has changed in fact but not in meaning.

revisions.old_reading: The sun is now huge, red and motionless on the horizon, beyond merely being hotter than in the traveller's own time.
revisions.new_reading: The sun is now even larger and duller with snow beginning, far beyond merely being hotter.
revisions.rationale: Hotter Sun Fact tracks a sun already become huge red and motionless, and Motionless Red Sun with Millennia-Long Sun Watching shows it growing even larger and duller while Crabs Gone Lifeless Snow shows cooling to snow.

changes.gist: The Traveller finds a motionless, nearly lifeless shore under bright stars, then watches an eclipse deepen into freezing, silent, absolute blackness.

changes.gist: The undecided narrator returns next day, finds the machine uncannily insubstantial, and leaves the Traveller equipping himself to deliver a promised proof in order to keep another engagement.

revisions.old_reading: The Full-size Time Machine is now back in the laboratory resting in the north-west after its far journey.
revisions.new_reading: The Full-size Time Machine is no longer resting in the laboratory; it has vanished with the Time Traveller.
revisions.rationale: The earlier situation placed the large machine back in the laboratory, but the vanishing shows the laboratory empty of the Traveller, meaning that placement no longer holds.

revisions.old_reading: The Withered White Flowers are now not only silent tokens but contested proof the Traveller appeals to in mute inquiry and refuses to surrender amid the Restless sceptical audience and Editor dismisses tale.

revisions.rationale: The earlier placing left the flowers as silent tokens later gazed on with mute inquiry, while the closing witness explicitly makes the shrivelled flowers stand for surviving gratitude and tenderness.

revisions.old_reading: The large machine is back in the laboratory after its far journey, resting in the north-west against the wall where seen.

constructions.relationship: contrast between assertion and self-doubt, and cause-and-consequence from privatized appeal to public dismissal
constructions.justification: True Despite Lying asserts literal truth, but Traveller doubts himself admits he hardly believes it himself, creating an assertion undercut from within. Scarred knuckles evidence and Withered white flowers show him appealing to body and flowers in mute inquiry as corroboration, while Refusal to give flowers shows him withholding the flowers from the Medical Man, turning potential public proof into private reassurance. Editor dismisses tale and Restless sceptical audience show that public reception becomes dismissal as fiction and restlessness. Together they yield a stalemate where insistence survives only privately because doubt and withholding license dismissal.
constructions.limitations: The units do not show the Traveller's motive for refusal, whether the audience inspected the scars, or whether surrendering the flowers would have persuaded anyone.

constructions.statement: The Traveller's fear that his journey was only a dream is dispelled when contact with the solid, travel-stained machine lets him redeclare his story as true.

contributors.role: provides the initial self-doubt that the journey was only a dream

constructions.relationship: contrast resolved by material verification: doubt opposed by tangible evidence leading to reaffirmation
constructions.justification: Traveller doubting his memory establishes fear of dream against prior truth-claim, Solid travel-stained machine supplies the physical evidence recorded as supporting Story affirmed as true, and Story affirmed as true converts that contact into an explicit reversal of the doubt, so together they show material verification resolving internal disbelief.
constructions.limitations: The units do not show whether the restored certainty is lasting or only momentary, or what the Traveller privately feels beyond his declaration.

constructions.statement: Even after the lamp-lit inspection of the solid, travel-stained machine and the renewed declaration that the story was true, the company dissolves in laughter with a mundane overwork explanation and a shouted good-night.

constructions.relationship: contrast between material verification and social dismissal
constructions.justification: Lamp-lit dash to corridor places the followers at the inspection, Solid travel-stained machine and Story affirmed as true together constitute verified proof plus renewed claim, while Laughing midnight farewell shows the party breaking up with laughter and a mundane overwork explanation, so joint inspection and assertion are met not by acceptance but by conventional dismissal.
constructions.limitations: The units show only outward laughter and the overwork diagnosis, not whether any guest was privately convinced or what they believed about the stains and damage.

constructions.statement: The Time Traveller's abrupt vanishing into a three-year absence leaves the narrator with a black and blank future filled only by imagined prehistoric wanderings and by the shrivelled white flowers witnessing that gratitude and tenderness survived in man.

contributors.role: provides the sudden disappearance that initiates loss
establishes the loss as enduring and fruitless over three years
defines the resulting condition as black and blank ignorance
supplies speculative imagination that fills the blank absence
provides the contrasting surviving material witness of tenderness

constructions.relationship: cause and consequence with contrast
constructions.justification: Traveller's Abrupt Vanishing causes Three-Year Vain Waiting, together establishing final non-return. That prolonged loss yields Future as Black Blank as the narrator's condition, which is then filled only by Speculated Prehistoric Wanderings. Withered White Flowers Witness contrasts with that blank speculation as the sole persisting proof that gratitude survived, so together they form a closing of absence compensated only by speculation and memorial token.
constructions.limitations: The units do not show the Traveller's fate, whether return remains possible, or whether the flowers convince anyone besides the narrator.
